chapters.name: 炫彩生活 家庭百味

words.ex: He accustoms himself to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他让自己习惯早起。
words.en: If you accustom yourself or someone else to something, you make yourself or them familiar with it or used to it.

words.ex: He has an addiction to video games.
words.ex_cn: 他对电子游戏上瘾了。
words.en: Addiction is the condition of being unable to stop using or doing something as a habit, especially something harmful.

words.ex: The ink blot ruined his homework.
words.ex_cn: 墨水污点弄脏了他的作业。
words.en: A blot is a mark or stain that spoils the appearance of something. It can also refer to an act that damages someone's reputation.

words.tr: adj. 国内的；公民的；民用的；
words.ex: The country is recovering from a civil war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在从一场内战中恢复。
words.en: relating to ordinary citizens and their concerns, as distinct from military or ecclesiastical matters.

words.tr:
n. 钩；扣；紧握；紧抱
v. 抱紧；握紧；扣紧
words.ex: The necklace has a gold clasp.
words.ex_cn: 这条项链有一个金色的钩。
words.en: A clasp is a small device that fastens something, or the act of holding someone or something tightly.

words.ex: They plant trees to commemorate the fallen soldiers.
words.ex_cn: 他们种树以纪念阵亡的士兵。
words.en: To commemorate an important event or person means to remember them by means of a special action, ceremony, or specially created object.

words.ex: He sent a letter of condolence to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他给朋友寄了一封慰问信。
words.en: An expression of sympathy, especially on the occasion of a death.

words.ex: We decorate the room for the party.
words.ex_cn: 我们为派对装饰房间。
words.en: To make something look more attractive by putting things on it or around it.

words.ex: She bought new decoration for her living room.
words.ex_cn: 她为客厅买了新的装饰品。
words.en: Decoration is the process or art of decorating something, or the objects used to decorate something.

words.ex: He felt discontent with his job.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的工作感到不满。
words.en: Discontent is a feeling of being unhappy because you are not satisfied with your situation or with what you have.

words.tr: adj. 不满的；不满意的; v. 不满意（discontent 的过去式及过去分词）
words.ex: He was discontented with his job.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的工作感到不满。
words.en: If you are discontented, you are not satisfied with your situation.

words.tr:
v. 使不再抱幻想；使理想破灭
n. 幻灭；理想破灭
words.ex: The bad experience disillusioned him about politics.
words.ex_cn: 这次糟糕的经历让他对政治不再抱幻想。
words.en: If a person or thing disillusions you, they make you realize that something is not as good as you thought it was.

words.tr: adj. 不再抱幻想的； v. “disillusion”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He became disillusioned after seeing the truth.
words.ex_cn: 在看到真相后，他不再抱幻想了。
words.en: If you are disillusioned with something, you are disappointed because it is not as good as you had expected.

words.tr: adj. 家庭的；国内的；驯养的；
words.ex: She prefers domestic chores over going out.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢做家务而不是外出。
words.en: Domestic means relating to the home, family, or household affairs. It can also refer to something that is made or produced within a country and not imported.

words.ex: This bag is durable and lasts for years.
words.ex_cn: 这个包很耐用，可以用很多年。
words.en: Something that is durable is strong and lasts a long time without breaking or becoming weaker.

words.ex: The duration of the movie is two hours.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的持续时间是两小时。
words.en: The duration of an event or state is the time during which it happens or exists.

words.ex: He dwells in a small house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他住在湖边的一所小房子里。
words.en: If you dwell on something, especially something unpleasant, you think, speak, or write about it a lot or for quite a long time.

words.tr:
n. 住宅；住所
v. 居住；栖身；沉湎于；“dwell”的现在分词
words.ex: He lives in a small dwelling near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他住在湖边的一个小住所里。
words.en: A dwelling is a place where someone lives, such as a house or apartment.

words.tr: adj. 溢于言表的；感情奔放的
words.ex: She was effusive in her praise for the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 她对老师的赞美非常热情。
words.en: If you describe someone's behaviour as effusive, you mean that they express pleasure, gratitude, or approval in a very enthusiastic way.

words.ex: He embarrassed himself in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在全班同学面前让自己丢脸了。
words.en: If you embarrass someone, you make them feel shy, ashamed, or guilty about something.

words.ex: He felt embarrassment when he tripped in front of everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他在众人面前绊倒时感到窘迫。
words.en: A feeling of self-consciousness, shame, or awkwardness.

words.ex: He finally embraced the new idea.
words.ex_cn: 他最终接受了这个新想法。
words.en: To take someone into your arms as a sign of love or affection, or to accept something enthusiastically.

words.ex: A bird emerged from the trees.
words.ex_cn: 一只鸟从树中浮现出来。
words.en: If something or someone emerges, they come out of or move out of something and become visible.

words.ex: The emergence of new technology changed our lives.
words.ex_cn: 新技术的出现改变了我们的生活。
words.en: The process of coming into view or becoming exposed after being concealed.

words.tr:
v. 遭遇；遇到；邂逅；
n. 遭遇；
words.ex: He encountered a bear while hiking in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他在森林里徒步时遭遇了一只熊。
words.en: If you encounter problems or difficulties, you experience them.

words.ex: The new job enriched his life.
words.ex_cn: 这份新工作使他的生活富裕起来。
words.en: To enrich something means to improve its quality, often by adding something to it.

words.ex: He showed great enthusiasm for learning English.
words.ex_cn: 他对学习英语表现出极大的热情。
words.en: Enthusiasm is a strong feeling of excitement and interest in something and a desire to become involved in it.

words.tr: n. 热心者；热衷于…的人
words.ex: He is an enthusiast of basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他是篮球的爱好者。
words.en: An enthusiast is a person who is very interested in a particular activity or subject and who spends a lot of time on it.

words.tr: adj. 充满热情的；热心的；
words.ex: He is enthusiastic about playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他对打篮球充满热情。
words.en: If you are enthusiastic about something, you show how much you like or enjoy it by the way that you behave and talk.

words.ex: She cheered enthusiastically for her team.
words.ex_cn: 她热情地为她的队伍加油。
words.en: If you do something enthusiastically, you do it with great eagerness and excitement.

words.ex: He is frugal with his money.
words.ex_cn: 他花钱很节俭。
words.en: If you describe someone as frugal, you mean that they are careful about spending money and use things only when they need to.

words.tr: v. 布置家具；配备；供给；提供
words.ex: He will furnish the apartment with new furniture.
words.ex_cn: 他将为公寓配备新家具。
words.en: To furnish a place means to put furniture and other things into it.

words.ex: The gossip about the CEO made everyone shocked.
words.ex_cn: 关于CEO的流言蜚语让所有人都震惊了。
words.en: Gossip is informal conversation or reports about other people's private lives, which might be unkind or not true.

words.tr: adj. 惯常的；习惯性的；经常的；
words.ex: He is a habitual smoker.
words.ex_cn: 他是个惯常的吸烟者。
words.en: A habitual action, state, or way of behaving is one that someone usually does or has, especially one that is considered to be typical or characteristic of them.

words.tr:
n. 锤子；
v. 锤打；
words.ex: He hit the nail with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子敲钉子。
words.en: A hammer is a tool that consists of a heavy piece of metal at the end of a handle, used for hitting things.

words.ex: The computer needs new hardware to run faster.
words.ex_cn: 这台电脑需要新的硬件来运行得更快。
words.en: In computing, hardware refers to the physical parts of a computer and related devices. In general, hardware can be any equipment, especially tools, used for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
n. 家庭；
adj. 家庭的；
words.ex: This household has three children.
words.ex_cn: 这个家庭有三个孩子。
words.en: A household is all the people in a family or group who live together in a house.

words.ex: The lamp illuminate the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯照亮了黑暗的房间。
words.en: To illuminate something means to shine light on it and to make it brighter and more visible.

words.tr: adj. 启发的； v. “illuminate”的现在分词；
words.ex: His explanation was illuminating.
words.ex_cn: 他的解释很有启发性。
words.en: Providing light or making something easier to understand.

words.ex: Birds inhabit the forest near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类居住在湖边的森林里。
words.en: If a place or region is inhabited by a group of people or a species of animal, those people or animals live there.

words.tr: v. 居住于；栖息；“inhabit”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The island is inhabited by a small community.
words.ex_cn: 这个岛屿上住着一个小社区。
words.en: If a place or region is inhabited by a group of people or a species of animal, those people or animals live there.

words.tr:
n. 小孩；
v. 开玩笑；
words.ex: The kid is playing with a ball.
words.ex_cn: 小孩在玩球。
words.en: A kid is a child or young person. As a verb, to kid means to tease or deceive someone in a playful way.

words.tr:
n. 租契；
v. 出租；
words.ex: He signed a lease for the apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他签了公寓的租契。
words.en: A lease is a legal agreement by which the owner of a building, a piece of land, or something such as a car allows someone else to use it for a period of time in return for money.

words.tr:
v. 躺；撒谎；
n. 谎言；
words.ex: The cat lies on the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 猫躺在沙发上。
words.en: If someone is lying, they are saying something which they know is not true.

words.tr:
v. 生活；居住；活着；
adj. 活的；现场的；实况转播的；
words.ex: They live in a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一所小房子里。
words.en: To live means to be alive, to have your home in a particular place, or to spend your life in a particular way.

words.ex: We waited in the lounge before our flight.
words.ex_cn: 我们在登机前等在休息室里。
words.en: A lounge is a room in a house or public building where people can sit and relax. As a verb, to lounge means to lie, sit, or stand in a relaxed or lazy way.

words.tr:
n. 脏乱；杂乱；
v. 弄糟；
words.ex: The room was a mess after the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对后房间一片狼藉。
words.en: A mess is a situation that is confused and full of problems, or something that is dirty or untidy.

words.ex: He talked nonsense and no one understood him.
words.ex_cn: 他说了一些无意义的话，没人能理解他。
words.en: If you say that something spoken or written is nonsense, you mean that you consider it to be untrue or silly.

words.tr: adj. 直截了当的；简单实用的
words.ex: He is a no-nonsense teacher who expects students to do their homework.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位不讲废话的老师，要求学生完成作业。
words.en: If you describe someone as no-nonsense, you approve of the fact that they are efficient, direct, and quite tough in their behavior or attitudes.

words.ex: The tree has many colorful ornaments.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树上有许多彩色的装饰品。
words.en: An ornament is an object that is used to make something look more attractive but is usually considered to have no practical purpose.

words.ex: He overheard them talking about the party.
words.ex_cn: 他无意中听到他们在谈论派对。
words.en: To overhear is to hear what someone is saying without them knowing that you are listening.

words.tr:
n. 垫；爪垫；便笺簿
v. 放轻脚步走
words.ex: She put a pad on the chair for comfort.
words.ex_cn: 她在椅子上放了一个垫子以增加舒适感。
words.en: A pad is a flat piece of material that is used to protect something, to make something more comfortable, or to absorb liquid.

words.ex: He picked up the parcel from the post office.
words.ex_cn: 他从邮局取了包裹。
words.en: A parcel is something wrapped in paper, usually so that it can be sent to someone by post.

words.tr:
v. 偷看；微露出；唧唧叫
n. 窥视；隐现；唧唧声
words.ex: He peeped through the keyhole to see what was inside.
words.ex_cn: 他从钥匙孔里偷看里面是什么。
words.en: To look quickly and often secretively at something or someone.

words.tr:
adj. 目前的；在场的；
n. 目前；礼物；
v. 呈现；提出；
words.ex: The present situation is very difficult.
words.ex_cn: 目前的形势非常困难。
words.en: If you say that someone is present at an event, you mean that they are there.

words.ex: He values his privacy and doesn't share personal info online.
words.ex_cn: 他重视自己的隐私，不在网上分享个人信息。
words.en: The state or condition of being free from being observed or disturbed by other people.

words.ex: He keeps his diary private.
words.ex_cn: 他把日记保密。
words.en: If something is private, it is for the use of one person or group, rather than for the general public.

words.ex: He told me privately that he was leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他私下告诉我他要离开。
words.en: If something is done privately, it is done without other people being present or knowing about it.

words.ex: He lost all his property in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他在火灾中失去了所有财产。
words.en: Something owned; a possession.

words.tr:
n. 架子；支架；齿条；破坏
v. 折磨；使痛苦；放在架上；累计（得分）
words.ex: He put the books on the rack.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在架子上。
words.en: A rack is a frame or shelf, usually with bars or hooks, that is used for holding things or for hanging things on. As a verb, to rack something means to cause great pain or suffering to someone.

words.ex: He wore a rag to clean the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块破布擦地板。
words.en: A rag is a piece of old cloth which you can use to clean or wipe things. As a verb, to rag means to tease or mock someone persistently.

words.ex: He will replace the broken chair.
words.ex_cn: 他将代替这把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: If one thing or person replaces another, the first is used or acts instead of the second.

words.ex: The deer walked through the scrub near the hill.
words.ex_cn: 鹿穿过了山边的灌木丛。
words.en: To scrub something means to rub it hard in order to clean it, especially using a stiff brush and water.

words.tr: v. 切断；脱离；切成两段
words.ex: He severed the rope with a knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用刀把绳子割断了。
words.en: To sever something means to cut through it or to break it off completely.

words.ex: The sweater shrinks in hot water.
words.ex_cn: 这件毛衣在热水中会收缩。
words.en: If something shrinks or you shrink it, it becomes smaller.

words.ex: The cloth shows shrinkage after washing.
words.ex_cn: 这块布在洗涤后出现了缩水。
words.en: The process, fact, or amount of shrinking.

words.ex: The simplicity of the design makes it easy to use.
words.ex_cn: 这种设计的简单使它容易使用。
words.en: The quality or condition of being easy to understand or do.

words.ex: He tries to simplify the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他试图简化这个数学问题。
words.en: If you simplify something, you make it easier to understand or you remove the things that make it complex.

words.ex: The coin fell into the slot.
words.ex_cn: 硬币掉进了狭槽里。
words.en: A slot is a narrow opening in a machine or container, for example a hole that you put coins in to make a machine work.

words.tr:
v. 洒；撒；下小雨
n. 洒；撒；小雨；少量
words.ex: She sprinkles sugar on her cereal.
words.ex_cn: 她在麦片上撒糖。
words.en: To scatter or pour small drops or particles of a substance over an object or surface.

words.ex: She tied the box with a thin string.
words.ex_cn: 她用一根细线把盒子绑了起来。
words.en: A string is a thin piece of rope or cord, or a series of things connected together.

words.tr:
v. 转换；
n. 开关；
words.ex: He switched off the light before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前把灯关掉了。
words.en: A switch is a small control for an electrical device which you use to turn the device on or off.

words.tr:
v. （使）纠缠；使陷入；使混乱
n. 纠缠；混乱；纠纷
words.ex: The cat got into a tangle with the yarn.
words.ex_cn: 猫和毛线缠在一起了。
words.en: If something is tangled or tangles, it becomes twisted together in an untidy way.

words.tr: v. 逐渐变细；逐渐减少；
words.ex: The candle tapers toward the top.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛向顶部逐渐变细。
words.en: A taper is a long thin candle or a gradual decrease in width or thickness.

words.tr:
v. （使）发痒；胳肢；逗乐
n. 痒；胳肢；呵痒
words.ex: The feather tickles my arm.
words.ex_cn: 羽毛挠得我手臂发痒。
words.en: If something tickles you, it touches you in a way that makes you laugh or feel slightly uncomfortable, usually because it is touching a sensitive part of your body. If something tickles you, it also makes you feel amused or pleased.

words.tr:
n. 琐事；少量
v. 玩弄；轻视
words.ex: He threw away a trifle of money on candy.
words.ex_cn: 他花了一点钱买糖果。
words.en: A trifle is something that is considered to have little importance, value, or significance. It can also refer to a small amount of something. As a verb, to trifle means to treat someone or something without seriousness or respect.

words.ex: We can utilize solar energy to power the house.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以利用太阳能来为房子供电。
words.en: To utilize something means to use it in a practical or effective way.

words.ex: Open the window to ventilate the room.
words.ex_cn: 打开窗户给房间通风。
words.en: To ventilate means to cause fresh air to enter and move around a room, building, etc., or to express your opinions or feelings about something openly.

words.ex: He wakes up at six every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上六点醒来。
words.en: To wake means to stop sleeping or to cause someone to stop sleeping. It can also refer to the trail left by a moving ship.

words.ex: The sun wakens the birds every morning.
words.ex_cn: 太阳每天早晨唤醒鸟儿。
words.en: to stop sleeping or to make someone stop sleeping

words.tr:
v. 打呵欠
n. 呵欠
words.ex: He yawned during the boring lecture.
words.ex_cn: 他在无聊的讲座上打哈欠。
words.en: If you yawn, you open your mouth very wide and breathe in more air than usual, often because you are tired or bored.

words.tr:
v. 叫喊
n. 喊叫
words.ex: He yells when he is angry.
words.ex_cn: 他生气时会大喊。
words.en: If you yell, you shout loudly, usually because you are excited, angry, or in pain.

words.tr: adj. 有…岁的； v. “age”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The aged man is 75 years old.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人75岁。
words.en: Having lived for a specified length of time; old.

words.tr:
adj. 备有空调装置的
v. 给…装上空调器；“air-condition”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The bus is air-conditioned.
words.ex_cn: 这辆公交车有空调。
words.en: Equipped with an air-conditioning system to control the temperature and humidity of the air.

words.ex: The jar is airtight, so the food stays fresh.
words.ex_cn: 这个罐子是密封的，所以食物能保持新鲜。
words.en: If something is airtight, it is completely sealed so that no air can get in or out.

words.ex: He flipped through the album with old photos.
words.ex_cn: 他翻看着装满旧照片的相册。
words.en: An album is a collection of several pieces of music, songs, or photographs that are intended to form a single item.

words.ex: The kitchen has a new washing appliance.
words.ex_cn: 厨房里有一台新的洗衣机。
words.en: An appliance is a device or machine that is used to perform a particular task, especially in the home.

words.ex: The children play in the backyard after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在后院玩耍。
words.en: A backyard is an area of land at the back of a house, often used for recreation or gardening.

words.ex: He drinks coffee on the balcony every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在阳台上喝咖啡。
words.en: A balcony is a platform on the outside of a building, enclosed by walls or balustrades, supported by columns or console brackets. The platform is projected from the wall of a building, usually above the ground floor.

words.ex: The band is playing music.
words.ex_cn: 这个乐队在演奏音乐。
words.en: A band is a group of musicians who play music together, especially popular music. It can also refer to a strip of material used for binding or decoration, or a range of frequencies or wavelengths in a spectrum.

words.tr: n. 栏杆的支柱；楼梯的扶栏
words.ex: He held the banister while walking up the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 他上楼梯时扶着栏杆的支柱。
words.en: A banister is the handrail on the side of a staircase, which people can hold onto for support.

words.ex: The toys are in the basement.
words.ex_cn: 玩具在地下室里。
words.en: The basement of a building is a room or area that is partly or completely below ground level.

words.ex: The remote needs a new battery.
words.ex_cn: 遥控器需要新电池。
words.en: A battery is a device that produces electricity to provide power for radios, cars, toys, etc.

words.ex: She threaded a bead onto the string.
words.ex_cn: 她把一颗有孔的小珠穿在绳子上。
words.en: A bead is a small piece of glass, wood, or plastic that is used for decorating clothes or making jewellery.

words.ex: The satellite beams signals to Earth.
words.ex_cn: 卫星向地球发射信号。
words.en: A beam is a long, thick piece of wood, metal, or concrete that is used to support the roof of a building. It can also refer to a line of light that shines from a bright object, or a smile that shows someone is very happy.

words.ex: He packed his belongings before moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他在搬去新城市前收拾好了自己的所有物。
words.en: Your belongings are the things that you own, especially things that are small enough to be carried.

words.ex: The wind turns the blade of the fan.
words.ex_cn: 风转动了风扇的叶片。
words.en: The flat cutting part of a tool or weapon, such as a knife or sword.

words.ex: The boiler heats water for the house.
words.ex_cn: 锅炉为房子加热水。
words.en: A boiler is a device that heats water or produces steam.

words.ex: The mechanic tightened the bolt with a wrench.
words.ex_cn: 机械师用扳手拧紧了螺栓。
words.en: A bolt is a type of fastener consisting of a threaded pin or rod with a head at one end, designed to be inserted through holes in assembled parts and tightened by a nut from the other end. It can also refer to a sudden dash or run, or to eat food quickly and without chewing.

words.ex: He does bookkeeping for his small shop.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的小商店做记账。
words.en: Bookkeeping is the job or activity of keeping an accurate record of the money that is spent and received by a business or other organization.

words.ex: He bought a magazine at the bookstall.
words.ex_cn: 他在报摊上买了一本杂志。
words.en: A bookstall is a small stand or shop, often outdoors, where books and sometimes magazines and newspapers are sold.

words.ex: He built a wall with red brick.
words.ex_cn: 他用红砖砌了一堵墙。
words.en: A brick is a rectangular block of baked clay used for building walls, which are usually red or brown.

words.ex: The bulb broke when it fell on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 灯泡掉到地上时碎了。
words.en: A bulb is the glass part of an electric lamp, which gives out light when electricity passes through it. It can also refer to a rounded underground storage organ present in some plants, notably those of the lily family, consisting of a short stem surrounded by fleshy scale leaves or leaf bases, lying dormant over winter.

words.ex: They live in a small bungalow near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一座小平房里。
words.en: A bungalow is a small house, usually having one story.

words.ex: He checks the calendar every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都看日历。
words.en: A calendar is a chart or device which displays the date and the day of the week, and often the whole of a particular year divided up into months, weeks, and days.

words.ex: Bread and rice are rich in carbohydrate.
words.ex_cn: 面包和米饭富含碳水化合物。
words.en: A carbohydrate is a substance found in foods such as bread, potatoes, and rice which provides your body with heat and energy and which consists of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen.

words.tr: n. 羊毛衫；开襟羊毛衫
words.ex: He wears a blue cardigan in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天穿一件蓝色开衫。
words.en: A cardigan is a type of knitted garment that has an open front, typically with buttons, and is worn over other clothes.

words.ex: The wine was stored in a large oak cask.
words.ex_cn: 葡萄酒储存在一个大橡木桶中。
words.en: A cask is a large barrel usually made of wood, used especially for storing liquids such as wine or beer.

words.ex: He keeps apples in the cellar.
words.ex_cn: 他把苹果存放在地窖里。
words.en: A cellar is a room underneath a house, often used for storing things such as wine or coal.

words.tr: n. 令人讨厌的或繁重的工作；
words.ex: Washing dishes is a boring chore.
words.ex_cn: 洗碗是一件烦人的琐事。
words.en: A chore is a task or piece of work that is often boring or unpleasant but needs to be done regularly.

words.tr:
n. 喧嚷；大声的要求
v. 喧嚷；大声地要求
words.ex: The crowd made a loud clamor for justice.
words.ex_cn: 人群为正义发出大声喧哗。
words.en: If people are clamoring for something, they are demanding it in a noisy or angry way.

words.tr:
n. 喧嚷；大声要求
v. 喧嚷；大声的要求
words.ex: The crowd made a loud clamour for justice.
words.ex_cn: 人群大声呼喊要求正义。
words.en: If people are clamouring for something, they are demanding it in a noisy or angry way.

words.tr:
n. 衣柜；壁橱；贮藏室
adj. 隐藏的
words.ex: He keeps his shirts in the closet.
words.ex_cn: 他把衬衫放在壁橱里。
words.en: A closet is a small room or space in a house or apartment where clothes, shoes, and other items are stored.

words.ex: He sat on the couch and watched TV.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在沙发上看电视。
words.en: A couch is a long, comfortable seat for two or more people to sit on. It is also used to refer to a piece of furniture designed for lying down or sleeping.

words.ex: He walks with a crutch after his accident.
words.ex_cn: 他事故后拄着拐杖走路。
words.en: A crutch is a stick with a handle and a part that fits under the arm, which you use to support your body if you are having difficulty in walking because of a foot or leg injury.

words.tr:
n. 袖口；裤子翻边；巴掌；手铐
v. 给...上袖口（或翻边）；用手掌轻拍；用巴掌打
words.ex: He rolled up his cuff to wash his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他卷起袖口来洗手。
words.en: The part at the end of a sleeve, where the material of the sleeve is turned back or a separate band is sewn on. Also, to fasten someone's hands together with a pair of handcuffs.

words.ex: She put the plates in the cupboard.
words.ex_cn: 她把盘子放在碗橱里。
words.en: A cupboard is a piece of furniture with doors and shelves that is used for storing things, usually in a kitchen.

words.ex: She put a cushion on the chair to make it comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 她在椅子上放了一个靠垫，让它更舒服。
words.en: A cushion is a soft bag of some ornamental material, stuffed with wool, hair, feathers, polyester staple fiber, non-woven material, or even paper torn into fragments. It may be used for sitting or kneeling upon, or to soften the hardness or angularity of a chair or couch.

words.tr: adj. 分离的； v. 脱离；拆卸；分离；“detach”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The house is detached from the neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子与邻居的房子是分开的。
words.en: If someone is detached, they do not have any emotional interest in a situation and therefore can make fair decisions.

words.tr: n. 洗涤剂；洗衣粉；去垢剂；
words.ex: She uses detergent to wash the clothes.
words.ex_cn: 她用洗涤剂洗衣服。
words.en: A detergent is a substance that is used for cleaning things, especially clothes and dishes.

words.ex: She put the dirty plates into the dishwasher.
words.ex_cn: 她把脏盘子放进洗碗机里。
words.en: A dishwasher is a machine that washes dirty dishes automatically.

words.tr: n. 穿衣； v. “dress”的现在分词；
words.ex: Every morning, she makes a quick dressing before leaving home.
words.ex_cn: 每天早上，她出门前都会快速穿衣。
words.en: A dressing is a sauce, especially one consisting of oil and vinegar mixed together with herbs or other flavorings, which you put on salad or other foods.

words.ex: I need to dry-clean my suit before the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 我需要在会议前把我的西装干洗一下。
words.en: To dry-clean something means to clean it using a chemical solvent rather than water.

words.ex: He threw the trash into the dustbin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: A dustbin is a container for waste, especially one that is kept outside a house or other building.

words.ex: She picked up a duster and started cleaning the shelves.
words.ex_cn: 她拿起一块抹布开始清理架子。
words.en: A duster is a cloth or brush that you use to remove dust from furniture, or a person whose job is to remove dust from places.

words.ex: The dustman collects trash every morning.
words.ex_cn: 垃圾清运工每天早上收集垃圾。
words.en: A dustman is a person whose job is to remove waste from outside houses and other buildings.

words.ex: She picked up the crumbs with a dustpan and brush.
words.ex_cn: 她用簸箕和刷子捡起了碎屑。
words.en: A dustpan is a flat container with a handle into which you brush dust and dirt.

words.ex: The book was dusty on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书在架子上积满了灰尘。
words.en: Covered with or resembling dust; dry and powdery.

words.ex: The old estate has large gardens and a beautiful mansion.
words.ex_cn: 这个古老的庄园有大片花园和一座美丽的豪宅。
words.en: An estate is all the money and property that someone owns, especially everything that is left when they die.

words.ex: The child lit a firecracker on New Year's Eve.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在除夕夜点燃了一个爆竹。
words.en: A firecracker is a small explosive device primarily designed to produce a large amount of noise, especially in the form of a loud bang; usually used in celebration.

words.ex: Children laughed as the firework lit up the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看着焰火点亮夜空，哈哈大笑。
words.en: A firework is a small device that is lit to produce a display of light, noise, and smoke, often used in celebrations.

words.tr:
n. 长子；长女；初生儿
adj. 头生的；第一胎生的
words.ex: She was the firstborn of the family.
words.ex_cn: 她是家里的长女。
words.en: The firstborn is the eldest child in a family.

words.tr:
n. 箔；陪衬物
v. 阻止；挫败
words.ex: He used foil to wrap the sandwich.
words.ex_cn: 他用锡纸包住了三明治。
words.en: To prevent someone from succeeding in their plans or intentions, especially by doing something clever or unexpected.

words.tr:
n. 折痕；褶；
v. 折叠；
words.ex: The paper has a deep fold in the middle.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸中间有一道深深的折痕。
words.en: To bend something, especially paper or cloth, so that one part of it lies flat on top of another part; to be able to be bent in this way.

words.tr:
n. 人们；人民；
adj. 民间的；
words.ex: The folk in the village are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 村子里的人们非常友好。
words.en: Folk can refer to people in general, or to a particular group of people. It can also refer to traditional music or customs of a community.

words.ex: This store sells many kinds of foodstuff.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售许多种类的食品。
words.en: Foodstuffs are substances that are used as food.

words.ex: He went to his grandfather's funeral.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加了他祖父的葬礼。
words.en: A funeral is a ceremony that is held because someone has died.

words.tr:
n. 漏斗；
v. 输送；
words.ex: He poured the oil through a funnel.
words.ex_cn: 他把油通过漏斗倒了进去。
words.en: A funnel is an object with a wide, circular top and a narrow tube at the bottom, used for pouring liquids or powders into containers with small openings.

words.ex: He bought a new gadget to clean his kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个新的小器具来清洁厨房。
words.en: A gadget is a small device or machine with a particular purpose.

words.ex: She bought a new garment for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一件新衣服。
words.en: A garment is a piece of clothing; used especially in contexts where you are talking about the manufacture or sale of clothes.

words.ex: The spider caught a fly in its gauze.
words.ex_cn: 蜘蛛在它的网里捉住了一只苍蝇。
words.en: Gauze is a thin, translucent fabric with a loose open weave, used for surgical dressings and other purposes.

words.ex: He adds ginger to his tea for flavor.
words.ex_cn: 他往茶里加姜来调味。
words.en: Ginger is a plant with a thick, knobby root that is used as a spice in cooking. It has a strong, spicy flavor and is also used in traditional medicine.

words.ex: He put on his glove before playing baseball.
words.ex_cn: 他在打棒球前戴上了手套。
words.en: A glove is a piece of clothing which covers your hand and wrist and has individual sections for each finger.

words.tr:
n. 胶；胶水；
v. 粘合；
words.ex: He used glue to stick the paper together.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶把纸粘在一起。
words.en: A sticky substance used for joining things together.

words.tr:
n. 坟墓；
adj. 严重的；
words.ex: They visited the grave of their grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他们参观了祖父的坟墓。
words.en: A grave is a place where a dead person is buried. When used as an adjective, grave means serious or solemn.

words.tr: n. 墓地；坟场；垃圾场；废物堆积处
words.ex: The old graveyard is quiet at night.
words.ex_cn: 那个古老的墓地晚上很安静。
words.en: A graveyard is an area of land, often near a church, where dead people are buried.

words.ex: The grime on the window made it hard to see outside.
words.ex_cn: 窗户上的尘垢让外面看不清楚。
words.en: Grime is dirt which has collected on the surface of something.

words.ex: The mother grooms her puppy every morning.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈每天早上给她的小狗梳理毛发。
words.en: A groom is a man who is getting married. Also, to groom means to clean and brush an animal, or to prepare someone for a particular job or position.

words.ex: The nail fits into the groove.
words.ex_cn: 钉子卡在槽里。
words.en: A groove is a long, narrow space or cut in a surface, often made to guide the movement of something or to hold something in place. It can also refer to a settled routine or way of doing things that is hard to change.

words.ex: He got a new haircut yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天理了一个新发型。
words.en: The act or process of cutting the hair.

words.tr: n. （汽车等）前灯；（矿工）头上戴的小型照明灯
words.ex: The car's headlamp illuminated the dark road ahead.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的前灯照亮了前方的黑暗道路。
words.en: A headlamp is a light attached to the front of a vehicle or to a person's head, used for illuminating the area ahead.

words.ex: The car's headlight is broken.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的前大灯坏了。
words.en: A headlight is a powerful light at the front of a vehicle, used for illuminating the road ahead.

words.tr: n. 戴在头上的耳机或听筒
words.ex: He wears a headset to listen to music.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着耳机听音乐。
words.en: A headset is a pair of headphones, especially one with a microphone attached.

words.tr: n. 加热；供暖设备；采暖； v. 加热；“heat”的现在分词；
words.ex: The heating of the room takes five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 房间的加热需要五分钟。
words.en: The process of making something warm or hot, or the system that does this.

words.tr:
adj. 高层的（建筑）
n. 高楼；大厦；多层建筑物
words.ex: He lives in a high-rise building near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一栋高楼里。
words.en: A high-rise building is a tall building with many floors.

words.tr: adj. 像家般舒适的；朴素的；
words.ex: The small cabin had a homely feel with soft blankets and a warm fire.
words.ex_cn: 这座小木屋有柔软的毛毯和温暖的火炉，感觉像家一样舒适。
words.en: If you describe something as homely, you mean that it is simple and plain, often in a way that is comforting. If you describe a person as homely, you mean that they are not very attractive.

words.ex: She put honey on her toast.
words.ex_cn: 她在吐司上涂了蜂蜜。
words.en: Honey is a sweet, sticky, yellowish-brown fluid made by bees and other insects from nectar collected from flowers.

words.ex: They went to Bali for their honeymoon.
words.ex_cn: 他们去巴厘岛度蜜月。
words.en: A honeymoon is a holiday taken by a newly married couple.

words.ex: He pulled the hood over his head to stay dry.
words.ex_cn: 他把兜帽拉到头上以保持干燥。
words.en: A hood is a part of a coat or jacket that you can pull up to cover your head.

words.tr: n. 住房供给； v. 收容；“house”的现在分词；
words.ex: The city needs more housing for low-income families.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市需要为低收入家庭提供更多的住房供给。
words.en: Housing refers to buildings or other shelters in which people live; a place to live.

words.ex: The lamp provides illumination in the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯为黑暗的房间提供照明。
words.en: The act of providing or casting light on something, or the state of being lit up; also, the clarification or elucidation of a subject or issue.

words.ex: The child showed signs of talent in infancy.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子在婴儿期就表现出天赋。
words.en: The earliest period of childhood, especially before the ability to walk has been acquired.

words.tr: adj. 适于居住的；可居住的
words.ex: The planet is not inhabitable because it is too hot.
words.ex_cn: 这颗行星不适合居住，因为它太热了。
words.en: Capable of being lived in; suitable for living in.

words.ex: The inhabitant lives in a small house.
words.ex_cn: 这位居民住在一所小房子里。
words.en: An inhabitant of a place is one of the people who live there.

words.ex: He received an invitation to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他收到了参加派对的邀请。
words.en: An invitation is a written or spoken request to come to an event such as a party, a meal, or a meeting.

words.ex: She stored jam in a glass jar.
words.ex_cn: 她把果酱存放在一个玻璃罐里。
words.en: A jar is a glass or clay container with a wide opening at the top and a lid, used especially for storing food.

words.ex: She put the kettle on to make tea.
words.ex_cn: 她把水壶放在炉子上烧水泡茶。
words.en: A kettle is a container or device in which water is boiled, having a lid, spout, and handle, used for making tea or coffee.

words.tr:
n. 地方；方位；
v. 安放；安置；
words.ex: This is a quiet place to read books.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个安静的地方读书。
words.en: A particular position or point in space.

words.ex: The lad is playing soccer with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 那个男孩正在和朋友们踢足球。
words.en: A lad is a young man or boy.

words.ex: The children carried paper lanterns at the festival.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在节日上提着纸灯笼。
words.en: A lantern is a lamp in a container that has a handle for holding or hanging it, and it usually has a protective case around the flame or bulb.

words.tr: n. 要洗的衣物；洗衣店；
words.ex: I put the dirty laundry in the washing machine.
words.ex_cn: 我把脏衣服放进洗衣机里。
words.en: Laundry refers to the clothes and linens that need to be washed or that have just been washed. It can also refer to the place or business where clothes and linens are washed and ironed.

words.ex: The lavatory is down the hall.
words.ex_cn: 洗手间在走廊尽头。
words.en: A lavatory is a room equipped with a toilet and sink for washing hands and face.

words.ex: The camera has a clear lens.
words.ex_cn: 这台相机有一个清晰的透镜。
words.en: A lens is a piece of curved glass or other transparent substance that is used in things such as cameras, telescopes, or pairs of glasses to make images larger or smaller.

words.ex: He put the lid on the box.
words.ex_cn: 他把盖子盖在盒子上。
words.en: A lid is a cover for a container, or the movable cover of the eye, known as the eyelid.

words.ex: She washed the linen in cold water.
words.ex_cn: 她用冷水洗亚麻布。
words.en: Linen is a kind of cloth that is made from the fibers of the flax plant. It is used to make clothes, sheets, and tablecloths.

words.ex: Farming is his main livelihood.
words.ex_cn: 务农是他的主要生计。
words.en: A person's livelihood is the way they earn money in order to live.

words.ex: We watch TV in the living room.
words.ex_cn: 我们在客厅看电视。
words.en: A room in a house for general and informal everyday use.

words.ex: The teacher used a loudspeaker to talk to the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师用扬声器对学生们讲话。
words.en: A loudspeaker is a piece of electronic equipment that makes sounds louder so that they can be heard at a greater distance.

words.ex: The makeup of the team includes students from five countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队的组成包括来自五个国家的学生。
words.en: Makeup refers to substances applied to the face to improve or alter the appearance, or the way in which something is composed or arranged.

words.ex: He lives in a big mansion near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他住在湖边的一座大宅子里。
words.en: A mansion is a very large, impressive house, especially one that is the home of a wealthy or important person.

words.tr: adj. 已婚的； v. 结婚；“marry”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: They are married and have two children.
words.ex_cn: 他们已婚，有两个孩子。
words.en: Having a husband or wife; united in matrimony.

words.ex: He put a mat on the floor to keep it clean.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上放了一块垫子以保持清洁。
words.en: A mat is a piece of thick fabric or other material that is placed on a floor or other surface to protect it or to provide a soft surface to stand or sit on.

words.ex: The birds mate in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟在春天交配。
words.en: A mate is a friend, someone you work with, or someone you are married to or in a sexual relationship with. As a verb, to mate means to have sex in order to produce young or to bring two animals together for breeding.

words.ex: He bought a new mattress for his bed.
words.ex_cn: 他为床买了一个新床垫。
words.en: A mattress is a large, flat pad that is placed on a bed to make it comfortable to sleep on.

words.ex: He had a mop of curly hair that always looked messy.
words.ex_cn: 他有一头乱蓬蓬的卷发，总是看起来很凌乱。
words.en: A mop is a tool for cleaning floors, consisting of a bundle of thick strings or a sponge attached to a long handle. As a verb, it means to clean or wipe something with a mop.

words.ex: He wiped his mouth with a napkin.
words.ex_cn: 他用纸巾擦了擦嘴。
words.en: A napkin is a piece of cloth or paper used at meals to protect your clothes and to wipe your mouth and fingers.

words.ex: The needy family received food from the charity.
words.ex_cn: 这个贫穷的家庭从慈善机构收到了食物。
words.en: Needy people do not have enough food, medicine, or clothing, or adequate houses.

words.ex: My brother's son is my nephew.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟的儿子是我的侄子。
words.en: A nephew is a son of one's sibling or sibling-in-law.

words.tr: n. 噩梦；不愉快的经历；
words.ex: He had a nightmare about falling from a tall building.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个从高楼坠落的噩梦。
words.en: A nightmare is a very frightening dream.

words.ex: The loud noise every night is a nuisance.
words.ex_cn: 每晚的噪音真是个讨厌的事。
words.en: A nuisance is a person, thing, or situation that is annoying or causes trouble.

words.ex: The children play at Nursery 796.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在796号托儿所玩耍。
words.en: A nursery is a place where young children are cared for during the day while their parents are at work.

words.ex: The dogs had three offspring last spring.
words.ex_cn: 这些狗去年春天生了三只幼崽。
words.en: Someone's offspring are their children.

words.tr: adj. 老式的；老派的；守旧的
words.ex: He wears an old-fashioned hat.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着一顶过时的帽子。
words.en: If you describe something as old-fashioned, you mean that it is no longer modern, current, or fashionable.

words.tr: n. 孤儿；失去生母的幼小动物
words.ex: The boy lives with his uncle because he is an orphan.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩和叔叔住在一起，因为他是个孤儿。
words.en: An orphan is a child whose parents are dead.

words.ex: The boy lives in an orphanage.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩住在孤儿院。
words.en: An orphanage is a place where children who have lost their parents or who have been abandoned by them are cared for and live.

words.ex: They live on the outskirts of the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市的郊区。
words.en: The outskirts of a city or town are the parts of it that are farthest away from its center.

words.ex: He filled the pail with water from the well.
words.ex_cn: 他从井里打了一桶水。
words.en: A pail is a bucket, usually made of metal or plastic, with a handle, used for carrying liquids or other substances.

words.ex: He put a paperweight on the letter to keep it from blowing away.
words.ex_cn: 他把一个镇纸放在信上，以防它被吹走。
words.en: A paperweight is a small heavy object which you place on papers to prevent them from being disturbed or blown away.

words.ex: The pendulum swings back and forth in the clock.
words.ex_cn: 钟摆在钟里来回摆动。
words.en: A pendulum is a weight that is hung from a fixed point so that it can swing freely, especially a rod with a weight at the end that regulates the mechanism of a clock.

words.tr:
n. 塞子；
v. 插上；
words.ex: The sink is clogged because the plug is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 水槽堵塞了，因为塞子卡住了。
words.en: A plug is a small object at the end of a wire that is used for connecting a piece of electrical equipment to the main supply of electricity. It is also a piece of material that is used for blocking a hole.

words.ex: A plume of smoke rose from the chimney.
words.ex_cn: 一股烟从烟囱里升起。
words.en: A plume is a large, soft, feather or a group of feathers, especially one that is used as a decoration.

words.ex: He sits on the porch and drinks coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在门廊上喝咖啡。
words.en: A porch is a covered shelter projecting in front of the entrance of a building.

words.ex: She is happy about her pregnancy.
words.ex_cn: 她对她的妊娠感到开心。
words.en: The condition of having a developing embryo or fetus in the body, especially in the uterus.

words.ex: She is pregnant and will have a baby next month.
words.ex_cn: 她怀孕了，下个月就要生宝宝了。
words.en: Having a baby developing in the uterus.

words.tr: n. 伪装；假象；虚伪的表现
words.ex: He was accused of using pretense to gain sympathy.
words.ex_cn: 他被指控利用伪装来博取同情。
words.en: A pretense is an action or way of behaving that is intended to make people believe something that is not true.

words.ex: The movie got a high rating from viewers.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影获得了观众的高评分。
words.en: A rating is a classification or ranking of someone or something based on a comparative assessment of their quality, standard, or performance.

words.ex: The removal of the old tree made the yard bigger.
words.ex_cn: 移除那棵老树让院子变大了。
words.en: The act of removing something or someone from a place or position.

words.tr: v. 租借；出租；“rend”的过去式和过去分词； n. 租金；
words.ex: They rent a small apartment in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们租了一间城市里的小公寓。
words.en: Rent refers to the payment made periodically by a tenant to a landlord for the use of property or land.

words.ex: The rental of the apartment costs $800 per month.
words.ex_cn: 这套公寓的租赁费用是每月800美元。
words.en: The act of paying for the use of something, such as property, a vehicle, or equipment, or the amount paid for such use.

words.ex: He will repay the loan next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月会偿还贷款。
words.en: If you repay a loan or a debt, you pay back the money that you owe to the person who you borrowed or took it from.

words.ex: He made the repayment on time.
words.ex_cn: 他按时还款了。
words.en: The action of paying back a loan or the money that has been borrowed.

words.ex: His residence is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他的住所靠近公园。
words.en: A residence is a house or place where someone lives.

words.ex: He lives in a residential area near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一个住宅区。
words.en: Relating to or suitable for residence.

words.ex: The family had a reunion last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 这家人上个星期天举行了团聚。
words.en: A reunion is a gathering of people who have been separated, especially members of a family or old friends, coming together again.

words.tr: v. 再结合；再统一；重聚
words.ex: The family will reunite next summer.
words.ex_cn: 这家人将在明年夏天重聚。
words.en: If people are reunited, or if someone reunites them, they meet each other again after they have been separated for some time.

words.ex: He carries a brown satchel to school.
words.ex_cn: 他背着一个棕色的书包去学校。
words.en: A satchel is a bag with a long strap, traditionally used for carrying books.

words.tr:
n. 缎子；缎子衣服
adj. 缎子似的；平滑而有光泽的
v. 对（纸等）作加光处理
words.ex: She wore a dress made of satin.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件缎子做的衣服。
words.en: Satin is a type of cloth that is smooth and shiny on one side and dull on the other.

words.ex: He scratched his scalp because it was itchy.
words.ex_cn: 他挠头皮，因为那里发痒。
words.en: The skin covering the top of the human head, or a trophy taken by cutting off the scalp of an enemy.

words.ex: He has a scar on his arm from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他手臂上有一道事故留下的伤疤。
words.en: A mark left on the skin after a wound or injury has healed, or the act of causing such a mark.

words.ex: She cut the paper with scissors.
words.ex_cn: 她用剪刀剪了纸。
words.en: Scissors are a tool used for cutting paper, cloth, hair, etc., consisting of two sharp blades fastened together in the middle so that the sharp edges slide against each other.

words.ex: The sun scorch the ground in summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天阳光灼烧地面。
words.en: To burn the surface of something so as to discolour or damage it.

words.tr: adj. 酷热的； v. “scorch”的现在分词；
words.ex: The scorching sun made the sand too hot to walk on.
words.ex_cn: 酷热的太阳使沙子热得无法赤脚行走。
words.en: If you describe the weather as scorching, you mean that it is extremely hot.

words.tr:
n. 小块；碎片；废金属；吵架
v. 废弃；取消
adj. 废弃的
words.ex: He picked up a scrap of paper from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起一张纸片。
words.en: A scrap is a small piece or amount of something, especially one that is left over after the greater part has been used. It can also mean to discard or get rid of something as being no longer useful or necessary.

words.ex: The children played on the seesaw at the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里玩跷跷板。
words.en: A seesaw is a long board which is balanced on a fixed part in the middle so that when one end goes up, the other goes down. It is used especially by children to play on.

words.tr: n. 长靠椅；有靠背的长椅；中长沙发
words.ex: They sat on the settee, discussing their plans for the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们坐在长椅上，讨论周末的计划。
words.en: A settee is a long comfortable seat with a back and arms, for two or more people to sit on.

words.ex: The city cleaned the sewage from the streets.
words.ex_cn: 城市清理了街道上的污水。
words.en: Sewage is waste matter such as faeces or dirty water from homes and factories, which flows away through sewers.

words.tr: n. 下水道；排水沟；缝纫者
words.ex: The sewer smells bad after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 下雨后，下水道闻起来很难闻。
words.en: A sewer is a large underground channel that carries off waste water and refuse.

words.ex: The city improved its sewerage system last year.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市去年改进了其排水系统。
words.en: The system of removing waste water and human excrement from homes and other buildings, and the waste material that is removed.

words.ex: He shaves every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上刮胡子。
words.en: To shave means to remove hair from the face or body by cutting it close to the skin with a razor.

words.tr:
n. 展示优点的场合（或机会）；
v. 展示…的优点；
words.ex: The competition was a showcase for her talent.
words.ex_cn: 这次比赛是她展示才华的机会。
words.en: A showcase is a setting in which someone or something is displayed to its best advantage, or a glass case used for displaying articles in a shop or museum.

words.ex: The sideboard was filled with fine china and silverware.
words.ex_cn: 餐具柜里摆满了精美的瓷器和银器。
words.en: A sideboard is a piece of furniture that is used for storing dishes, glasses, and other items used for serving food and drink. It is typically placed in a dining room.

words.tr:
n. 筛子；滤器
v. 筛；滤
words.ex: He used a sieve to separate sand from pebbles.
words.ex_cn: 他用筛子把沙子和石子分开。
words.en: A sieve is a tool consisting of a wire or plastic mesh held in a frame, used for separating solids from liquids or larger particles from smaller ones.

words.ex: He left his slipper under the bed.
words.ex_cn: 他把拖鞋落在床下了。
words.en: A slipper is a kind of soft shoe that you wear at home.

words.tr:
v. 睡眠
n. 睡眠（常复数）
words.ex: The baby fell into a deep slumber after feeding.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝喂完奶后进入了深深的睡眠。
words.en: Slumber is a state of sleep, especially one that is peaceful and restful.

words.tr:
adj. 温暖舒适的；紧密的；紧身的；贴身的
n. 酒馆内的雅间
words.ex: The cottage was snug and warm, perfect for a winter retreat.
words.ex_cn: 这间小屋舒适温暖，是冬季度假的完美之地。
words.en: If you feel snug or are in a snug place, you are very warm and comfortable, especially because you are protected from cold or danger.

words.ex: The sun softened the ice on the road.
words.ex_cn: 太阳使路上的冰变软了。
words.en: To make or become soft or softer.

words.tr: n. 老处女；未婚女人；老姑娘；
words.ex: The old spinster lived alone in a small house.
words.ex_cn: 那位老处女独自住在一所小房子里。
words.en: A spinster is an unmarried woman, especially an older woman who seems unlikely to marry.

words.ex: The sponge lives in the ocean and filters water for food.
words.ex_cn: 这种海绵动物生活在海洋中，通过过滤水来获取食物。
words.en: A sponge is a piece of a soft, light, porous substance originally from the skeletons of marine creatures, used for washing, cleaning, or padding. As a verb, it means to wipe, rub, or clean with a sponge or to absorb something.

words.ex: He bought a gift for his spouse.
words.ex_cn: 他给他的配偶买了一份礼物。
words.en: A spouse is a person's partner in marriage.

words.tr:
n. 污点；
v. 玷污；
words.ex: There is a coffee stain on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一个咖啡污点。
words.en: A stain is a mark on something that is difficult to remove, especially one made by a liquid such as blood or coffee. To stain something means to leave a mark on it that is difficult to remove.

words.tr:
n. 立体声；立体声音响
adj. 立体声的
words.ex: He plays music on the stereo.
words.ex_cn: 他通过立体声收音机播放音乐。
words.en: A stereo is a sound system that uses two or more separate microphones to record sound and two or more loudspeakers to play it back, so that you hear different parts of the sound coming from different directions.

words.ex: He put a stopper in the bottle to keep the liquid from spilling.
words.ex_cn: 他把塞子塞进瓶子里，防止液体洒出来。
words.en: A stopper is a plug or a cork for closing a bottle or other container, or something that stops or blocks movement or progress.

words.ex: He cooks soup on the stove.
words.ex_cn: 他用炉子煮汤。
words.en: A stove is a piece of equipment which provides heat, either for cooking or for heating a room.

words.ex: He fastened the strap around his wrist.
words.ex_cn: 他把带子系在手腕上。
words.en: A strap is a narrow piece of leather, cloth, or other material that is used to fasten, secure, or carry something, or to hold onto something.

words.ex: They live in a quiet suburb outside the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市外一个安静的市郊。
words.en: A suburb is a residential district located on the outskirts of a city.

words.ex: They live in a suburban neighborhood near the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在靠近城市的市郊社区。
words.en: Suburban means relating to a suburb, which is an area on the edge of a large town or city where people live. It often implies a residential area with a lower population density than the inner city.

words.ex: They booked a hotel suite for their honeymoon.
words.ex_cn: 他们为蜜月预订了一间酒店套房。
words.en: A set of rooms designated for use together, especially in a hotel; a set of musical compositions designed to be performed in a sequence.

words.ex: He calls her sweetheart every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都叫她亲爱的。
words.en: A sweetheart is a person with whom one is in love or has a romantic relationship.

words.tr:
v. 利用；
n. 水龙头；轻拍；轻敲；轻击；
words.ex: The company tapped local talent to grow its business.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司利用本地人才来发展业务。
words.en: If you tap something, you hit it with a quick light blow or a series of quick light blows. A tap is a device that controls the flow of a liquid or gas from a pipe or container, for example on a sink.

words.tr: v. 由电视播送；用电视放映
words.ex: The news will televise the election results tonight.
words.ex_cn: 今晚电视将播出选举结果。
words.en: To broadcast something on television.

words.tr: n. （房屋、土地等的）租用期限；租赁；
words.ex: The tenancy lasts for one year.
words.ex_cn: 租期为一年。
words.en: The period of time for which a property is rented.

words.ex: The tenant pays rent every month.
words.ex_cn: 房客每个月支付租金。
words.en: A tenant is a person who rents land or property from a landlord.

words.ex: He crossed the threshold of adulthood at 18.
words.ex_cn: 他在18岁时进入了成年的起始点。
words.en: The threshold of something is the point at which it begins or changes.

words.ex: They laid new tile in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 他们在厨房铺了新的瓷砖。
words.en: A tile is a flat piece of baked clay, carpet, cork, or other material, used especially for covering roofs and floors.

words.ex: He used a torch to find his keys in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他用手电筒在黑暗中找钥匙。
words.en: A torch is a stick with a flame on one end that is used as a source of light, or a portable battery-powered electric lamp.

words.ex: He always keeps his garden trim and neat.
words.ex_cn: 他总是把花园打理得整洁有序。
words.en: To trim something means to make it tidier or more level by cutting a small amount off it.

words.ex: He poured water into the tub.
words.ex_cn: 他把水倒进了桶里。
words.en: A tub is a large, open container that you fill with water and use to wash yourself or to wash clothes.

words.ex: He opened his umbrella when it started to rain.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨时，他打开了伞。
words.en: An umbrella is a device consisting of a circular canopy of fabric on a folding metal frame, used as protection against rain or sunlight.

words.tr: adj. 弱势的；下层社会的；贫困的
words.ex: The school helps underprivileged children learn to read.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校帮助弱势儿童学习阅读。
words.en: People who are underprivileged lack the advantages that other people have, such as enough money or a good standard of living.

words.ex: The diary helped unlock the mystery of her disappearance.
words.ex_cn: 这本日记帮助揭开了她失踪的谜团。
words.en: To unlock something means to open it, or to make it possible for someone to open it, by turning a key or pushing a button.

words.ex: Please unplug the charger after it's done.
words.ex_cn: 充电完成后请拔掉充电器。
words.en: To unplug an electrical device means to disconnect it from its power supply by removing its plug from a socket.

words.ex: My auntie gave me a cake for my birthday.
words.ex_cn: 我伯母送了我一块蛋糕作为生日礼物。
words.en: Someone's auntie is the sister of their mother or father, or the wife of their uncle.

words.ex: His upbringing taught him to be honest and kind.
words.ex_cn: 他的抚育让他学会了诚实和善良。
words.en: The way that a child is cared for and taught how to behave while it is growing up.

words.tr:
adj. 在（或向）市郊住宅区的；城镇非中心区的
adv. 离开市中心；往（去或在）城镇非中心区
n. 住宅区；城镇非中心区
words.ex: He lives in an uptown apartment near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在靠近公园的市郊住宅区的公寓里。
words.en: Uptown refers to the residential area of a city or town, away from the central business district.

words.ex: The urban area has many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市地区有许多高楼。
words.en: relating to a city or town

words.ex: He picked up a spoon, a common utensil.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起了一把勺子，一种常见的餐具。
words.en: An utensil is a tool that you use in your home, especially in the kitchen, for example, a knife, fork, or spoon.

words.ex: She wore a white veil on her wedding day.
words.ex_cn: 她在婚礼那天戴了一条白色的面纱。
words.en: A veil is a piece of thin soft cloth that women sometimes wear over their heads and which can also cover their face.

words.ex: They live in a big villa near the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在海边的一座大别墅里。
words.en: A villa is a fairly large house, especially one that is used for holidays in Mediterranean countries.

words.ex: He put his clothes in the wardrobe.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服放进衣橱里。
words.en: A wardrobe is a tall cupboard or cabinet in which you can hang your clothes.

words.tr: n. 要洗的衣物；洗好的衣物； v. 洗；洗涤；“wash”的现在分词；
words.ex: She put the washing into the machine.
words.ex_cn: 她把要洗的衣物放进洗衣机里。
words.en: The act of cleaning something using water and usually soap or detergent.

words.tr:
n. 蜡；
v. 给…上蜡；
words.ex: Bees make wax to build their hives.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂用蜡建造蜂巢。
words.en: Wax is a solid, slightly shiny substance made of fat or oil that is used to make candles, polish, and other products. It can also refer to the process of applying wax to something or the natural substance found in the ear.

words.ex: He is a wealthy man who owns many houses.
words.ex_cn: 他是个富有的人，拥有许多房子。
words.en: A wealthy person, organization, or country has a lot of money, resources, or assets.

words.ex: The two companies will wed next month.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司下个月将合并。
words.en: To marry someone; to join in marriage.

words.ex: Exercise helps with your well-being.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有助于你的健康。
words.en: The state of being comfortable, healthy, or happy.

words.tr: adj. 富裕的；富有的；有钱的
words.ex: The well-to-do family bought a big house.
words.ex_cn: 这个富裕的家庭买了一栋大房子。
words.en: Someone who is well-to-do is wealthy and has a high standard of living.

words.tr: n. 风车；风车房；玩具风车；
words.ex: The windmill turns slowly in the breeze.
words.ex_cn: 风车在微风中缓缓转动。
words.en: A windmill is a structure with long parts at the top that are turned around by the wind and produce power to crush grain or produce electricity.

words.ex: She knits a sweater from wool.
words.ex_cn: 她用羊毛织毛衣。
words.en: Wool is the hair that grows on sheep and some other animals, which is used to make clothes, blankets, etc.

words.ex: The zip on my jacket is broken.
words.ex_cn: 我的夹克上的拉链坏了。
words.en: A zip is a device used to fasten openings in clothes or bags, consisting of two rows of metal or plastic teeth that are pulled together or apart by a sliding tab. It can also refer to energy or speed.

words.ex: He zipped up his jacket with the zipper.
words.ex_cn: 他用拉链拉上了夹克。
words.en: A zipper is a device consisting of two strips of metal or plastic with interlocking projections closed or opened by pulling a slide along them, used to fasten openings in clothing, bags, etc.

chapters.name: 炫彩生活 购物美食

words.ex: The sponge absorbs water quickly.
words.ex_cn: 海绵很快吸收水。
words.en: If something absorbs a liquid, gas, or other substance, it soaks it up or takes it in.

words.tr: v. 吸收；“absorb”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The sponge absorbed the water quickly.
words.ex_cn: 海绵很快吸收了水。
words.en: If you are absorbed in something, you are very interested in it and your attention is fully occupied by it.

words.ex: This phone is affordable for students.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机对学生来说价格合理。
words.en: If something is affordable, most people have enough money to buy it.

words.tr:
n. 业余爱好者；
adj. 业余的；
words.ex: He is an amateur who paints on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他是个周末画画的业余爱好者。
words.en: An amateur is someone who does something as a hobby and not as a job.

words.ex: The clown amuses the children with funny tricks.
words.ex_cn: 小丑用滑稽的把戏娱乐孩子们。
words.en: If something amuses you, it makes you want to laugh or smile.

words.ex: Children find amusement in playing games.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在玩游戏时感到快乐。
words.en: Amusement is the feeling that you have when you think that something is funny or entertaining.

words.ex: There was an array of people at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会上人山人海。
words.en: An array of different things or people is a large number or wide range of them.

words.ex: The balloon will ascend into the sky.
words.ex_cn: 气球将升上天空。
words.en: If you ascend a hill or staircase, you go up it. If a staircase or path ascends, it leads up to a higher place.

words.tr: adj. 可获得的；有空的；可用的；
words.ex: The books are available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在图书馆里可以借到。
words.en: If something is available, it is able to be used or obtained.

words.ex: The availability of free Wi-Fi is important for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 免费Wi-Fi的可用性对旅行者很重要。
words.en: The quality of being able to be used or obtained.

words.ex: The soup was too bland for me.
words.ex_cn: 这汤太淡了，我不喜欢。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as bland, you mean that they are rather dull and unexciting.

words.tr:
n. 弹跳；跳动；
v. 弹跳；反弹；
words.ex: The ball had a high bounce on the concrete.
words.ex_cn: 球在混凝土上弹跳得很高。
words.en: If something bounces or if you bounce it, it moves away from a surface after hitting it.

words.tr:
n. 全体演员；
v. 投掷；扔；投射；
words.ex: The cast of the play performed very well.
words.ex_cn: 这部剧的全体演员表演得非常好。
words.en: To cast something means to throw it forcefully in a particular direction.

words.ex: The restaurant caters to vegetarians.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅满足素食者的需求。
words.en: To cater means to provide food and drink at an event, often as a business service, or to provide what is needed or wanted by a particular person or group.

words.ex: He became the champion of the tennis tournament.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了网球锦标赛的冠军。
words.en: A champion is someone who has won first prize in a competition, contest, or fight.

words.ex: The car consumes a lot of gas.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车消耗很多汽油。
words.en: To consume something means to eat or drink it, or to use it up in some way.

words.ex: The consumer buys food at the store.
words.ex_cn: 消费者在商店购买食物。
words.en: A consumer is a person who buys goods or uses services.

words.ex: Many people believe consumerism leads to waste.
words.ex_cn: 许多人认为消费主义会导致浪费。
words.en: Consumerism is the belief that it is good to buy and use a lot of goods and services, often associated with the idea that happiness can be achieved through consumption.

words.ex: She ate a crisp apple for snack.
words.ex_cn: 她吃了一个脆苹果当点心。
words.en: Something that is crisp is hard, and makes a pleasant sound when you break it or crush it.

words.ex: The restaurant serves a famous delicacy called seafood soup.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅供应一道著名的佳肴，叫海鲜汤。
words.en: Delicacy refers to the quality of being delicate, fine, or subtle in appearance, structure, or manner. It can also denote a choice or rare food item.

words.tr: v. 吞食；吞噬；狼吞虎咽地吃；如饥似渴地看
words.ex: The dog devoured the meat quickly.
words.ex_cn: 狗很快地把肉吃光了。
words.en: To eat something quickly and eagerly, especially because you are very hungry; to destroy something quickly and completely.

words.ex: The stomach digests food into nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 胃将食物消化成营养物质。
words.en: To digest means to break down food in the stomach and intestines into substances that can be absorbed by the body. It can also mean to understand or assimilate information. As a noun, it refers to a compilation or summary of information.

words.ex: The digestive system breaks down food.
words.ex_cn: 消化系统分解食物。
words.en: Relating to the process of digesting food.

words.tr:
n. 折扣；
v. 不全信；不重视；
words.ex: The store gave a 20% discount on all shoes.
words.ex_cn: 商店对所有鞋子提供了20%的折扣。
words.en: A reduction in the usual price of something, or the act of reducing the price.

words.tr:
n. 展示；陈列；
v. 展示；陈列；
words.ex: The store has a big display of new phones.
words.ex_cn: 商店里有一个新手机的展示。
words.en: To display something means to put it in a place where people can see it easily, or to show it to people.

words.tr:
n. 潜水；跳水；暴跌；
v. 潜水；跳水；暴跌；
words.ex: He went for a dive in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他去海里潜水。
words.en: If you dive into water, you jump in head-first with your arms held straight above your head. Dive is also a noun.

words.tr:
n. 安逸；轻松；
v. 缓解；减轻；
words.ex: He enjoys the ease of living in a quiet village.
words.ex_cn: 他享受住在安静村庄里的安逸。
words.en: If you talk about the ease of a particular activity, you are referring to the way that it has been made easier to do, or to the fact that it is already easy to do. Ease is also a state of being comfortable and without worry or anxiety.

words.ex: This math problem is easy.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很容易。
words.en: If a job or action is easy, you can do it without difficulty because it is not complicated and causes no problems.

words.ex: He can solve the problem easily.
words.ex_cn: 他很容易就能解决这个问题。
words.en: Without difficulty or effort.

words.tr: adj. 可食用的；可以吃的；
words.ex: These mushrooms are edible and safe to eat.
words.ex_cn: 这些蘑菇是可食用的，安全可以吃。
words.en: Fit to be eaten as food.

words.ex: The mushrooms are inedible and dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 这些蘑菇不能吃，而且危险。
words.en: If something is inedible, it is not suitable for eating because it is unpleasant or harmful.

words.ex: The elephant is enormous.
words.ex_cn: 这头大象非常巨大。
words.en: If you describe something as enormous, you are emphasizing that it is extremely large in size or amount.

words.ex: The movie was enormously popular.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影极度受欢迎。
words.en: To a very great degree or extent; extremely.

words.ex: The clown entertains the children with funny tricks.
words.ex_cn: 小丑用滑稽的把戏娱乐孩子们。
words.en: To entertain someone means to amuse or interest them, for example by telling them stories or jokes, or by playing music for them.

words.tr: adj. 有趣的；使人愉快的； v. 款待；“entertain”的现在分词；
words.ex: The clown gave an entertaining show.
words.ex_cn: 小丑表演了一场有趣的节目。
words.en: Providing amusement or enjoyment.

words.tr: n. 表演者；艺人；款待的人
words.ex: The entertainer sang and danced for the children.
words.ex_cn: 这位表演者为孩子们唱歌跳舞。
words.en: An entertainer is a person whose job is to amuse or interest people, for example by telling jokes, singing, or dancing.

words.ex: The museum will exhibit ancient coins next month.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆下个月将展览古钱币。
words.en: To exhibit something means to show it in a public place so that people can go to see it. It can also mean to show a particular quality, ability, or type of behavior.

words.ex: The museum held an exhibition of ancient art.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆举办了一场古代艺术展览。
words.en: An exhibition is a public display of works of art or items of interest, often held in a museum or art gallery.

words.tr: v. 扩大；膨胀；更充分地阐述；
words.ex: The company plans to expand its business to other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划将其业务扩大到其他国家。
words.en: To increase in size, number, or importance, or to make something increase in this way.

words.ex: The expense of the trip was higher than expected.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行的费用比预期的要高。
words.en: An expense is the amount of money that you spend on something.

words.tr:
n. 车费；费用；
v. 进展；成功（或不成功等）；
words.ex: The bus fare is two dollars.
words.ex_cn: 公交车费是两美元。
words.en: The fare is the amount of money that you pay for a journey that you make, for example, in a bus, train, or taxi.

words.ex: She loves to follow the latest fashion.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢追随最新的时尚。
words.en: Fashion is a popular style of clothes, hair, etc. at a particular time.

words.ex: They had a feast on New Year's Day.
words.ex_cn: 他们在元旦举办了一场盛宴。
words.en: A feast is a large and special meal, often to celebrate something.

words.ex: He grimaced when he tasted the bitter medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他喝下苦涩的药时皱起了脸。
words.en: A grimace is an ugly, twisted expression on a person's face, usually because they are experiencing pain or strong feelings.

words.ex: He stepped on my heel by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心踩到了我的脚后跟。
words.en: The heel is the back part of the foot, below the ankle. It can also refer to the part of a shoe or boot that supports this part of the foot.

words.ex: Sugar is an ingredient in this cake.
words.ex_cn: 糖是这个蛋糕的一个成分。
words.en: An ingredient is one of the substances that are combined to make something, especially in cooking.

words.tr:
adj. 立即的；即时的；
n. 瞬间；立即；
words.ex: He wants an instant answer.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一个立即的回答。
words.en: An instant is a very short period of time, or a particular point in time.

words.ex: He answered the question instantly.
words.ex_cn: 他立即回答了问题。
words.en: If something happens instantly, it happens immediately.

words.tr:
n. 标签；
v. 用标签标明；
words.ex: The bottle has a label with the name of the drink.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子上有一个写着饮料名称的标签。
words.en: A label is a piece of paper, polymer, cloth, metal, or other material affixed to a container or article, on which is written or printed information or symbols about the product or item.

words.ex: He reads books in his leisure.
words.ex_cn: 他在空闲时间读书。
words.en: Leisure is the time when you are not working and you can relax and do things that you enjoy.

words.tr:
adj. 悠闲的；从容的；
adv. 悠闲地；从容地；
words.ex: He took a leisurely walk in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园里悠闲地散步。
words.en: If you do something in a leisurely way, you do it in a relaxed and unhurried manner.

words.tr:
v. 点击；
n. 咔哒声；
words.ex: Click the button to start the game.
words.ex_cn: 点击按钮开始游戏。
words.en: To make a short, sharp sound, or to press a button on a computer mouse or other device to select something on a screen.

words.tr:
n. 一条（面包）
v. 游荡；虚度光阴
words.ex: He bought a loaf of bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 他从面包店买了一条面包。
words.en: A loaf is a quantity of bread that is shaped and baked in one piece and usually sliced before being eaten. As a verb, to loaf means to spend time in a lazy way, doing nothing in particular.

words.ex: She stayed in a luxurious hotel with gold faucets.
words.ex_cn: 她住进了一家有金色水龙头的奢侈酒店。
words.en: Something that is luxurious is very comfortable and expensive, and often involves great pleasure or indulgence.

words.tr: n. 奢华；奢侈品；难得的享受；
words.ex: She bought a luxury dress for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一件奢华的裙子。
words.en: Luxury is very great comfort, especially among beautiful and expensive surroundings.

words.ex: He wore a scary mask at the Halloween party.
words.ex_cn: 他在万圣节派对上戴了一个可怕的面具。
words.en: A mask is a piece of cloth or other material that you wear over your face to hide or protect it.

words.ex: This phone is outdated and doesn't work well.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机过时了，用起来不好。
words.en: If you describe something as outdated, you mean that you think it is old-fashioned and no longer useful or relevant to modern life.

words.tr: v. 做得过分；使…过度；过多使用
words.ex: Don't overdo the sugar in your tea.
words.ex_cn: 别在茶里放太多糖。
words.en: To do something to an excessive degree; to exaggerate or overuse something.

words.tr: v. 兜售；沿街叫卖； 散播
words.ex: He tries to peddle fake watches on the street.
words.ex_cn: 他试图在街上兜售假手表。
words.en: To peddle goods or ideas means to try to sell them or make them accepted by going from place to place.

words.tr:
n. 流行音乐；
v. 发出砰的一声；突然地行动；
words.ex: I love listening to pop on the radio.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在收音机里听流行音乐。
words.en: To make a short, sharp, explosive sound; to appear suddenly and unexpectedly.

words.ex: She tried to prevail on him to change his mind.
words.ex_cn: 她试图劝服他改变主意。
words.en: If a proposal, principle, or opinion prevails, it gains influence or is accepted, often after a struggle or argument.

words.tr: adj. 盛行的；有优势的；普遍的； v. “prevail”的现在分词；
words.ex: The prevailing weather today is sunny.
words.ex_cn: 今天盛行的天气是晴天。
words.en: The prevailing thing in a particular place or at a particular time is the one that is most common or strongest at that place or time.

words.tr:
n. 购买；采购；
v. 购买；采购；
words.ex: The purchase of a new car took all his savings.
words.ex_cn: 买一辆新车花光了他所有的积蓄。
words.en: To purchase something means to buy it. It can also refer to something that has been bought.

words.ex: His recipe for success is hard work and patience.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的秘诀是努力工作和耐心。
words.en: A recipe is a list of ingredients and a set of instructions that tell you how to cook something.

words.tr: n. 娱乐；消遣；休闲活动
words.ex: Reading books is his favorite recreation.
words.ex_cn: 读书是他最喜欢的消遣。
words.en: Recreation is activity that you do for enjoyment or amusement when you are not working.

words.ex: He enjoys recreational activities like swimming and hiking.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢游泳和徒步等娱乐活动。
words.en: Relating to or denoting activity done for enjoyment when one is not working.

words.tr: n. 切片；薄片；部分；片段；
words.ex: She ate a slice of bread for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她早餐吃了一片面包。
words.en: A slice of something is a thin piece or portion of it.

words.tr:
n. 污点；渍痕；浓烟
v. （使）变脏；（使）模糊
words.ex: There is a smudge on the window.
words.ex_cn: 窗户上有一个污点。
words.en: A smudge is a dirty mark or smear. As a verb, to smudge means to make something dirty or to blur it by rubbing.

words.tr:
adj. 唯一的；
n. 鞋底；
words.ex: He is the sole owner of the shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是这家商店唯一的主人。
words.en: If you describe something as the sole thing of a particular kind, you mean that it is the only one of that kind.

words.ex: He solely depends on his bike to go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他只靠自行车去上班。
words.en: If something is solely the case, it is the only thing that is the case.

words.ex: He squandered all his money on games.
words.ex_cn: 他把所有的钱都浪费在游戏上了。
words.en: If you squander money, resources, or opportunities, you waste them in a foolish or careless way.

words.tr:
n. 长条；条状；
v. 剥去；剥夺；
words.ex: He cut a strip of paper to wrap the gift.
words.ex_cn: 他剪了一条纸来包装礼物。
words.en: To remove a layer from something, or to take off your clothes.

words.ex: The baby suck milk from the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿从奶瓶里吮吸牛奶。
words.en: To draw something into the mouth by creating a partial vacuum with the lips and tongue; to be very bad or unpleasant.

words.ex: The food at this restaurant is superb.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅的食物极佳。
words.en: If something is superb, its quality is very good indeed.

words.tr:
v. 用布包裹；用绷带缠
n. 长而宽的一长条；割刈的带状地
words.ex: She swathed the baby in a soft blanket.
words.ex_cn: 她用一条柔软的毯子把婴儿裹起来。
words.en: To wrap or bind in or as if in a bandage or cloth.

words.tr: adj. 彻底的；完全的；详尽的；
words.ex: He did a thorough cleaning of the house.
words.ex_cn: 他对房子进行了彻底的清洁。
words.en: A thorough action or activity is one that is done very carefully and in a detailed way so that nothing is forgotten.

words.ex: He cleaned the room thoroughly.
words.ex_cn: 他彻底地打扫了房间。
words.en: In a thorough manner; completely and carefully.

words.ex: His thoroughness in checking the answers ensured no mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他检查答案时的彻底确保了没有错误。
words.en: The quality of being complete with regard to every detail; exactness.

words.ex: She ate a slice of toast for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她早餐吃了一片烤面包。
words.en: Toast is bread which has been cut into slices and made brown and crisp by cooking at a high temperature. Toast is also a drink in which you wish someone happiness or success.

words.tr: n. 象征物；标志；代金券；代币；
words.ex: The dove is a token of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征物。
words.en: A token is something that represents or stands for something else, especially a piece of metal or plastic that you can use instead of money in some machines or as a symbol of a particular feeling or event.

words.tr: adj. 值得…的；值得尊敬的；
words.ex: This book is worthy of reading.
words.ex_cn: 这本书值得读。
words.en: If something or someone is worthy of something, they deserve it because they have the qualities or abilities required.

words.ex: She bought a warm wrap for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一件保暖的包裹（披肩）过冬。
words.en: To cover or enclose something in paper, cloth, or other material.

words.ex: He bought a new accessory for his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的手机买了一个新配件。
words.en: An accessory is something such as a bag or piece of jewelry that you wear or carry because it is attractive.

words.ex: The singer sang with piano accompaniment.
words.ex_cn: 歌手在钢琴伴奏下演唱。
words.en: An accompaniment is a musical part which supports or partners a solo instrument, voice, or group.

words.tr: n. 杂技演员；立场观点善变的人
words.ex: The acrobat jumps high on the tightrope.
words.ex_cn: 杂技演员在钢丝上跳得很高。
words.en: An acrobat is someone who entertains people by performing difficult physical acts such as jumping and balancing, especially in a circus.

words.ex: He has an appetite for spicy food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢辛辣食物。
words.en: A desire or liking for something, especially food.

words.ex: The audience clapped loudly after the show.
words.ex_cn: 演出结束后，观众热烈鼓掌。
words.en: The group of spectators at a public event; listeners or viewers collectively, especially those attending a performance or reading a particular work.

words.ex: The school concert was held in the auditorium.
words.ex_cn: 学校的音乐会是在礼堂举行的。
words.en: An auditorium is the part of a theatre, concert hall, or other public building in which the audience sits.

words.ex: He ate eggs and bacon for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了鸡蛋和培根。
words.en: Bacon is a type of salt-cured pork made from various cuts, typically from the pork belly or from back cuts, which are less fatty than the belly.

words.tr: n. 羽毛球运动；羽毛球；
words.ex: He plays badminton every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打羽毛球。
words.en: A game played with rackets and a shuttlecock, which is hit back and forth across a high net.

words.ex: I bought fresh bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 我从面包房买了新鲜面包。
words.en: A bakery is a place where bread, cakes, and pastries are made or sold.

words.ex: She practices ballet every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 她每天下午练习芭蕾舞。
words.en: Ballet is a type of performance dance that originated during the Italian Renaissance in the 15th century and later developed into a concert dance form in France and Russia. It has since become a widespread, highly technical form of dance with its own vocabulary based on French terminology. It has been globally influential and has defined the foundational techniques used in many other dance genres.

words.tr: n. 气球；热气球；玩具气球；球状物；
words.ex: The child held a red balloon at the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在派对上拿着一个红色的气球。
words.en: A balloon is a small, thin, rubber bag that you blow air into so that it becomes larger and rounder or longer. Balloons are used as toys or decorations.

words.ex: They had a big banquet after the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼后他们举办了一场盛大的宴会。
words.en: A banquet is a large formal meal for many people, often followed by speeches in honor of someone.

words.tr: n. 条状物；酒吧；栅栏；棒；
words.ex: He ate a chocolate bar after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一条巧克力。
words.en: A bar is a place where alcoholic drinks are served, or a long, narrow piece of metal or wood used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: We had a barbecue in the park last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们在公园举行了户外烧烤。
words.en: A barbecue is a meal or gathering at which meat, fish, or other food is cooked out of doors on a rack over an open fire or on a special appliance.

words.ex: He ate a bowl of beans for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一碗豆子。
words.en: A bean is a seed from one of several genera of the flowering plant family Fabaceae, which are used for human or animal food.

words.ex: He cooked beet soup for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他为晚餐煮了甜菜汤。
words.en: A beet is a plant with a round dark red root that is eaten as a vegetable.

words.ex: He drinks a cold beverage after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后喝一杯冷饮。
words.en: A drink, especially one other than water; a liquid for drinking.

words.ex: He ate soup from a bowl.
words.ex_cn: 他从碗里吃汤。
words.en: A bowl is a round container with a wide uncovered top. Some kinds of bowl are used, for example, for serving or eating food from, or in cooking, while other larger kinds are often used for washing or other purposes.

words.ex: He loves boxing and trains every day.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢拳击运动，每天训练。
words.en: Boxing is a sport in which two people fight each other using their fists, usually while wearing padded gloves.

words.ex: She wears a silver bracelet every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天戴一条银手链。
words.en: A bracelet is a piece of jewellery that you wear around your wrist or arm.

words.ex: He drinks brandy after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后喝白兰地。
words.en: Brandy is a strong alcoholic drink made from wine or fermented fruit juice.

words.tr:
v. 酿造；沏；酝酿
n. 酿造的饮料；啤酒
words.ex: He brews coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上冲咖啡。
words.en: If you brew tea or coffee, you make it by pouring hot water over tea leaves or ground coffee. If you brew beer, you make it by soaking grain in water and then fermenting it.

words.ex: We had dinner at a buffet with many dishes to choose from.
words.ex_cn: 我们在自助餐吃了晚饭，有很多菜可以选。
