words.ex_cn: 他很少吃快餐。
words.en: Not often; seldom.

words.ex: I recently bought a new book.
words.ex_cn: 我最近买了一本新书。
words.en: If something happened recently, it happened only a short time ago.

words.ex: He repeatedly asked for help.
words.ex_cn: 他再三地请求帮助。
words.en: If something is done repeatedly, it is done again and again.

words.ex: There are roughly 100 students in the class.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级大约有100名学生。
words.en: In a manner that is not exact or detailed; approximately.

words.tr: adv. 似乎；看似；表面上看；
words.ex: He is seemingly calm, but he is nervous inside.
words.ex_cn: 他似乎很平静，但内心很紧张。
words.en: appearing to be true or real but not necessarily so

words.ex: He will arrive shortly.
words.ex_cn: 他不久就会到。
words.en: In a short time; soon.

words.ex: He sings and plays guitar simultaneously.
words.ex_cn: 他一边唱歌一边弹吉他。
words.en: If two or more things happen simultaneously, they happen at exactly the same time.

words.ex: The room is slightly warmer than before.
words.ex_cn: 房间比以前稍微暖和一点。
words.en: To a small degree; not considerably.

words.ex: This tool is specially designed for children.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具是专门为儿童设计的。
words.en: In a special manner; particularly.

words.tr: adv. 直角地；径直地；公平地；直接了当
words.ex: He stood squarely in front of the door.
words.ex_cn: 他直角地站在门前面。
words.en: If something is squarely placed or aimed, it is placed or aimed directly at something.

words.ex: Suddenly, the light went out.
words.ex_cn: 突然，灯灭了。
words.en: If something happens suddenly, it happens quickly and unexpectedly.

words.ex: He will surely come tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天一定会来。
words.en: without doubt; certainly

words.tr: adv. 在那附近；大约；上下；左右
words.ex: He lives thereabouts, near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在附近，公园旁边。
words.en: You use thereabouts to indicate that an amount, number, time, or place is not exact but is close to the correct one.

words.tr:
adv. 仍然；还是；
adj. 静止的；
words.ex: He is still waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然在等公交车。
words.en: If a situation that used to exist still exists, it has continued and exists now.

words.ex: I truly appreciate your help.
words.ex_cn: 我衷心感谢你的帮助。
words.en: You use truly to emphasize that something has all the features or qualities of a particular thing, or is the case to the fullest possible extent.

words.ex: Unlike his brother, he likes quiet places.
words.ex_cn: 不像他的兄弟，他喜欢安静的地方。
words.en: If one thing is unlike another thing, the two things are different in nature or in appearance.

words.ex: He will call you upon his arrival.
words.ex_cn: 他一到就会给你打电话。
words.en: On or onto a surface or position above or on top of something.

words.tr: adj. 通常的；寻常的；惯常的；
words.ex: He takes the usual bus to work.
words.ex_cn: 他通常坐这路公交车去上班。
words.en: If something is usual, it happens most often or was most often the case in the past.

words.ex: The red team played versus the blue team.
words.ex_cn: 红队与蓝队比赛。
words.en: Used to indicate the two sides in a competition or conflict.

words.ex: He is virtually always on time.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎总是准时。
words.en: In effect though not formally recognized; practically.

words.tr: adv. （用以询问大概的地方）在什么地方；
words.ex: I don't know his whereabouts.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道他在什么地方。
words.en: The place where someone or something is.

words.ex: He likes coffee, whereas she prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，然而她更喜欢茶。
words.en: You use whereas to introduce a comment which contrasts with what is said in the main clause.

words.ex: He found a way whereby he could save money.
words.ex_cn: 他找到了一种借以省钱的方法。
words.en: You use whereby to introduce a clause in which you mention the means by which something happens.

words.tr:
pron. 无论哪个；
adj. 无论哪个的；
words.ex: You can pick whichever book you like.
words.ex_cn: 你可以选无论哪本书。
words.en: You use whichever to refer to any one of a group of things or people, when it does not matter which one is chosen or considered.

words.ex: Whoever wants to join can sign up.
words.ex_cn: 任何想加入的人都可以报名。
words.en: used to refer to any person or people, when it does not matter who

words.ex: He is wholly responsible for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他完全对这个错误负责。
words.en: Completely or entirely.

chapters.name: 附录一:新闻英语常用词汇

words.tr:
n. 滥用；虐待；辱骂；
v. 滥用；虐待；辱骂；
words.ex: The abuse of power led to many problems.
words.ex_cn: 权力的滥用导致了许多问题。
words.en: Abuse is the improper usage or treatment of a thing, often to unfairly or improperly gain benefit. Abuse can come in many forms, such as physical or verbal maltreatment, injury, assault, violation, rape, unjust practices, crimes, or other types of aggression.

words.ex: He was arrested as an accomplice to the robbery.
words.ex_cn: 他因作为抢劫的帮凶而被逮捕。
words.en: An accomplice is someone who helps another person to commit a crime.

words.ex: The two countries signed an accord to stop the war.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了一项协议以停止战争。
words.en: An accord is an official agreement or treaty. It can also refer to a state of agreement or harmony.

words.tr: phrase. 代理总统；临时代理总统职务的人
words.ex: The acting president will take over the duties until the election is held.
words.ex_cn: 代理总统将接管职责，直到选举举行。
words.en: An acting president is a person who temporarily fills the role of president, usually in the absence of the elected president.

words.tr: phrase. 执政党；政府派；行政当局所属政党
words.ex: The administration party made a new rule.
words.ex_cn: 执政党制定了一项新规定。
words.en: The political party currently in power and running the government.

words.ex: The aftermath of the storm left many trees down.
words.ex_cn: 风暴过后，许多树被吹倒了。
words.en: The aftermath of an important event, especially a harmful one, is the situation that results from it.

words.ex: We will review the meeting agenda tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天将审查会议议程。
words.en: An agenda is a list or plan of things to be done or considered, especially in a meeting.

words.tr:
n. 帮助；援助；
v. 帮助；协助；
words.ex: The charity provided aid to the flood victims.
words.ex_cn: 慈善机构向洪水受害者提供了帮助。
words.en: To aid someone means to help or assist them. Aid can also refer to the help or support given.

words.ex: The air crash happened last night.
words.ex_cn: 空难发生在昨晚。
words.en: An air crash is an accident in which an aircraft is destroyed or damaged as a result of a collision, especially while in flight.

words.ex: The air is clean after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后空气很清新。
words.en: Air is the invisible gaseous substance surrounding the earth, a mixture mainly of oxygen and nitrogen.

words.ex: He is an ambassador to France.
words.ex_cn: 他是驻法国的大使。
words.en: An ambassador is an official envoy, especially a high-ranking diplomat who represents a state and is usually accredited to another sovereign state or to an international organization as the resident representative of their own government or sovereign or appointed for a special and often temporary diplomatic assignment.

words.ex: The amendment changed the old law.
words.ex_cn: 这项修正案改变了旧法律。
words.en: An amendment is a change or addition to a law or document.

words.tr: v. 废除；取消；宣告无效
words.ex: The court will annul the marriage.
words.ex_cn: 法院将宣布婚姻无效。
words.en: To annul something means to declare it invalid or to officially say that it no longer exists.

words.tr: n. 反腐败，反贪腐；廉政风暴
words.ex: The government launched an anti-corruption campaign.
words.ex_cn: 政府发起了一项反腐败运动。
words.en: Opposed to or intended to prevent corruption.

words.ex: The armed forces protect the country.
words.ex_cn: 武装部队保卫国家。
words.en: The armed forces of a country are its military forces, including the army, navy, and air force.

words.tr: phrase. 持械抢劫；武装抢劫（指使用武器进行的抢劫行为）
words.ex: The convenience store was the scene of an armed robbery last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚，这家便利店发生了一起持械抢劫案。
words.en: Armed robbery is the crime of stealing from someone or somewhere using a weapon.

words.ex: The police arrested the thief last night.
words.ex_cn: 警察昨晚逮捕了那个小偷。
words.en: If the police arrest you, they take charge of you and take you to a police station, because they believe you may have committed a crime.

words.tr: phrase. 逮捕令；由法院或法官签发的授权警方逮捕某人的正式文件
words.ex: The police obtained an arrest warrant for the suspect.
words.ex_cn: 警方获得了对嫌疑人的逮捕令。
words.en: An arrest warrant is a document issued by a judge or magistrate that authorizes the police to arrest a person.

words.ex: The man was arrested for arson.
words.ex_cn: 这名男子因纵火被逮捕。
words.en: The crime of deliberately setting fire to property.

words.tr: v. 攻击；困扰；抨击；袭击
words.ex: The storm assailed the small village.
words.ex_cn: 风暴袭击了这个小村庄。
words.en: If someone assails you, they attack you violently, either physically or with words.

words.ex: The king was killed by an assassin.
words.ex_cn: 国王被一名刺客杀害了。
words.en: An assassin is a person who murders an important person for political or religious reasons.

words.ex: The police investigated the assault on the old man.
words.ex_cn: 警方调查了对那位老人的攻击。
words.en: An assault is a physical attack on someone, or a military attack on a place.

words.tr: phrase. 一般的；普遍；未被捕；详尽
words.ex: The issue is important at large.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题在一般情况下很重要。
words.en: If someone dangerous is at large, they are not in prison or have not been caught. It also means discussing something in a general way without considering details.

words.tr: phrase. 在危险中；处于成败关头
words.ex: His job is at stake if he is late again.
words.ex_cn: 如果他再迟到，他的工作就保不住了。
words.en: If something is at stake, it is being risked and might be lost or damaged if something goes wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 权威的；可信的；有权威性的信息
words.ex: The website provides authoritative information about health.
words.ex_cn: 这个网站提供关于健康的权威信息。
words.en: Information that is considered reliable and accurate, often coming from a recognized expert or source.

words.tr: n. 当局；官方；权威；“authority”的复数；
words.ex: The authorities closed the park for safety reasons.
words.ex_cn: 当局为了安全原因关闭了公园。
words.en: The people or organizations that are in charge of a particular country or area and have the power to make laws and enforce them.

words.tr:
v. 使困惑；难倒；阻碍
n. 挡板；遮护物；阻碍体
words.ex: The magic trick baffled the children.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术让孩子们感到困惑。
words.en: If something baffles you, you cannot understand it or explain it.

words.tr:
n. 保释（金）
v. 保释；（往外）舀水
words.ex: He paid bail to get out of jail.
words.ex_cn: 他交了保释金以便出狱。
words.en: Bail is a sum of money that a person who has been accused of a crime pays to a law court so that they can be released until their trial. The payment is a way of making sure that the accused will return to court for trial.

words.tr:
v. 进行无记名投票 
n. 无记名投票
words.ex: He cast his ballot in the election.
words.ex_cn: 他在选举中投了票。
words.en: A ballot is a process of voting, in writing and typically in secret. It is also the piece of paper on which you mark your vote.

words.tr:
v. 禁止；
n. 禁止；
words.ex: The school bans phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If there is a ban on something, it is not allowed. If something is banned, it is not allowed to be done, shown, or used.

words.tr: n. 条状物；酒吧；栅栏；棒；
words.ex: He ate a chocolate bar after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一条巧克力。
words.en: A bar is a place where alcoholic drinks are served, or a long, narrow piece of metal or wood used for a particular purpose.

words.tr: v. 招手示意；举手召唤；引诱
words.ex: He beckoned to the boy to come closer.
words.ex_cn: 他向那个男孩招手示意过来。
words.en: If you beckon to someone, you signal to them to come to you, usually by a gesture of your hand.

words.tr:
n. 努力争取；出价；投标；
v. 出价；投标；
words.ex: His bid for the championship inspired everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他为冠军所做的努力鼓舞了所有人。
words.en: To bid means to offer a particular amount of money for something that is being sold, especially at an auction, or to offer to do work or provide services for a particular price.

words.ex: The black market for rare books thrives in this city.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的珍本书黑市非常兴旺。
words.en: The black market refers to the illegal trade of goods and services, which evades official regulations, taxes, or prohibitions.

words.tr:
n. 勒索；敲诈
v. 勒索；讹诈
words.ex: He threatened to tell the truth unless she paid him money — that's blackmail.
words.ex_cn: 他威胁说，除非她付钱，否则就说出真相——这就是敲诈。
words.en: Blackmail is the action of threatening to reveal a secret about someone, unless they do something you want, such as give you money.

words.tr: n. 一阵强劲的气流；爆炸；
words.ex: A blast of cold wind hit the window.
words.ex_cn: 一阵冷风击中了窗户。
words.en: A blast is a sudden loud noise or a strong gust of wind. It can also refer to an explosion or the act of blowing something up. As a verb, it means to explode or to criticize severely.

words.tr:
n. 烈火；火焰；闪耀
v. 闪耀；熊熊燃烧；发亮光
words.ex: The fire began to blaze in the woods.
words.ex_cn: 火在森林里开始猛烈燃烧。
words.en: A blaze is a very large or fiercely burning fire that is difficult to control.

words.tr: adj. 无望的；凄凉的；荒凉的；
words.ex: The future looks bleak without a job.
words.ex_cn: 没有工作，未来看起来毫无希望。
words.en: If you describe a situation as bleak, you mean that it seems unlikely to improve or get better.

words.tr:
n. 阻塞；封锁
v. 封锁
words.ex: The blockade stopped all ships from entering the port.
words.ex_cn: 封锁阻止了所有船只进入港口。
words.en: A blockade is an action to prevent goods or people from entering or leaving a place.

words.tr:
n. 炸弹
v. 投弹于；轰炸
words.ex: The bomb exploded at noon.
words.ex_cn: 炸弹在中午爆炸了。
words.en: A bomb is a device which explodes and damages or destroys a large area.

words.ex: The bomb squad was called in to defuse the suspicious package.
words.ex_cn: 炸弹拆除小组被召来拆除可疑包裹。
words.en: A bomb squad is a group of police officers or soldiers who are trained to deal with bombs and other explosive devices.

words.ex: The city had an economic boom after the new factory opened.
words.ex_cn: 新工厂开业后，这座城市迎来了经济繁荣。
words.en: If there is a boom in the economy, there is an increase in economic activity, for example in the amount of things that are being bought and sold.

words.tr:
v. 促进；使增长；
n. 提高；增强；
words.ex: Exercise can boost your energy.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进你的精力。
words.en: If one thing boosts another, it causes it to increase, improve, or be more successful.

words.tr:
n. 抵制；拒绝参加；
v. 抵制；拒绝参加；
words.ex: The students organized a boycott of the unfair school rule.
words.ex_cn: 学生们组织了对这项不公平校规的抵制。
words.en: If a country, group, or person boycotts a country, organization, or activity, they refuse to be involved with it in any way because they disapprove of it.

words.tr: n. 非法闯入；入室行窃
words.ex: The police investigated a break-in at the store last night.
words.ex_cn: 警方调查了昨晚商店的非法闯入事件。
words.en: An act of illegally entering a building, especially by force, in order to steal something.

words.ex: He went to jail for bribery.
words.ex_cn: 他因贿赂而入狱。
words.en: Bribery is the act of offering, giving, receiving, or soliciting something of value for the purpose of influencing the action of an official in the discharge of his or her public or legal duties.

words.tr:
n. 预算；预算金额；
adj. 廉价的；花钱少的；
v. 为 ... 做预算；
words.ex: We made a budget for our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行制定了一个预算。
words.en: A budget is a plan that shows how much money a person or organization will earn and how much they will need or be able to spend.

words.ex: A bug crawled on the leaf.
words.ex_cn: 一只小虫子爬在叶子上。
words.en: A bug is a small insect, or it can refer to a fault in a computer program or system.

words.ex: The police caught the man after the burglary.
words.ex_cn: 警察在盗窃后抓住了那个男人。
words.en: Burglary is the crime of illegally entering a building and stealing things.

words.tr: n. （政治、商业或社会性）活动；运动；
words.ex: The city launched a campaign to reduce plastic waste.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市发起了一项减少塑料垃圾的活动。
words.en: A campaign is a planned set of activities that people carry out over a period of time in order to achieve something such as social or political change.

words.ex: He is a candidate for the mayor position.
words.ex_cn: 他是市长职位的候选人。
words.en: A candidate is someone who is being considered for a position, for example someone who is running in an election or applying for a job.

words.tr: phrase. 盗窃汽车内财物的人；汽车窃贼
words.ex: The car burglars managed to break into the vehicle without triggering the alarm.
words.ex_cn: 汽车窃贼设法在没有触发警报的情况下闯入了车辆。
words.en: Individuals who break into cars to steal items or the car itself.

words.ex: He is a career criminal who stole many times.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名惯犯，多次行窃。
words.en: A person who makes a living by committing crimes, often repeatedly and over a long period of time.

words.ex: The accident caused many casualties.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故造成了许多伤亡人员。
words.en: A casualty is a person who is killed or injured in a war or in an accident.

words.tr: n. （通常指永久性的）停火，停战; 停火命令
words.ex: The two countries agreed to a ceasefire after years of war.
words.ex_cn: 两国在多年战争后同意停火。
words.en: A ceasefire is an agreement in which countries or groups that are fighting each other agree to stop fighting.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；首要的；
n. 领袖；首领；
words.ex: He is the chief reason for the team's success.
words.ex_cn: 他是球队成功的主要原因。
words.en: The chief is the leader of a group or organization, or the main part of something.

words.ex: Child abuse is a serious crime that requires immediate intervention.
words.ex_cn: 虐待儿童是一种严重的犯罪，需要立即干预。
words.en: Child abuse refers to the physical, sexual, or emotional mistreatment or neglect of a child or children.

words.ex: He cited a book in his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他在文章中引用了一本书。
words.en: To cite something means to quote it or mention it as evidence or proof of what you are saying.

words.tr:
v. 声称；索赔；
n. 声称；索要；
words.ex: He claims that he saw a UFO last night.
words.ex_cn: 他声称自己昨晚看到了不明飞行物。
words.en: If you say that someone claims that something is true, you mean they say that it is true but you are not sure whether or not they are telling the truth.

words.ex: The two teams clashed during the match.
words.ex_cn: 这两支队伍在比赛中发生了冲突。
words.en: A clash is a loud, harsh noise, like the clash of cymbals. It can also refer to a conflict or disagreement.

words.ex: He used cocaine last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚用了可卡因。
words.en: A drug obtained from the leaves of the coca plant, used as a local anesthetic and also illegally as a stimulant.

words.tr:
n. 倒塌；崩溃；暴跌；
v. 倒塌；崩溃；
words.ex: The collapse of the old bridge caused many problems.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧桥的倒塌引起了诸多问题。
words.en: If a building or other structure collapses, it falls down very suddenly.

words.ex: The public condemned the corrupt politician.
words.ex_cn: 公众谴责了这位腐败的政客。
words.en: If you condemn something, you say that it is very bad and unacceptable.

words.tr: phrase. 保守党（英国主要政党之一，主张传统价值观和保守政策）
words.ex: The conservative party won the election last year.
words.ex_cn: 保守党去年赢得了选举。
words.en: The Conservative Party is a political party in the United Kingdom that promotes conservative policies and values, emphasizing tradition, limited government, and free market principles.

words.ex: The politician lost his constituency after the scandal.
words.ex_cn: 这位政客在丑闻后失去了他的支持者。
words.en: A constituency is a group of people in a country or area who are entitled to vote in an election, or the area itself.

words.tr:
v. 定罪；宣判有罪
n. 罪犯；囚犯
words.ex: The court convicted him of theft.
words.ex_cn: 法院判定他犯有盗窃罪。
words.en: If someone is convicted of a crime, they are found guilty of that crime in a court of law.

words.ex: The government punished the official for corruption.
words.ex_cn: 政府因贪污惩罚了那名官员。
words.en: Corruption is dishonest or illegal behavior, especially by people in positions of power.

words.ex: He tried to counterfeit money.
words.ex_cn: 他试图伪造货币。
words.en: Made in exact imitation of something valuable with the intention to deceive or defraud.

words.tr: phrase. 信用卡欺诈；利用他人信用卡信息进行非法交易的行为
words.ex: The rise in credit card fraud has led to increased security measures.
words.ex_cn: 信用卡欺诈的增加导致了安全措施的加强。
words.en: Credit card fraud is a wide-ranging term for theft and fraud committed using or involving a payment card, such as a credit card or debit card, as a fraudulent source of funds in a transaction.

words.ex: The crime rate in this city is low.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的犯罪率很低。
words.en: The crime rate is the number of crimes that are committed in a particular area during a particular period of time.

words.tr:
adj. 犯罪的；
n. 罪犯；
words.ex: He made a criminal mistake by stealing money.
words.ex_cn: 他偷钱犯了一个犯罪的错误。
words.en: A criminal is a person who has committed a crime.

words.ex: He tried to curb his horse with the reins.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用缰绳勒住马。
words.en: If you curb something, you control it and keep it within limits.

words.tr:
v. 切；割；削减；
n. 切；割；削减；
words.ex: He cut the apple with a knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用刀切了苹果。
words.en: To make an opening, incision, or wound in (something) with a sharp-edged tool or object.

words.ex: He finished his homework before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 他在截止日期前完成了作业。
words.en: A deadline is a time or date before which a particular task must be finished or a particular thing must be done.

words.ex: The two teams are in a deadlock over the budget.
words.ex_cn: 两个团队在预算上陷入了僵局。
words.en: A deadlock is a situation in which no progress can be made or no agreement is reached, especially because of a disagreement between two or more parties.

words.tr: phrase. 致命的武器；能造成死亡的器械
words.ex: He was arrested for carrying a deadly weapon.
words.ex_cn: 他因携带致命武器而被逮捕。
words.en: A deadly weapon is any object or substance designed or used in such a way that it is capable of causing death or serious bodily injury.

words.tr:
v. 处理；对付；交易；
n. 交易；协议；
words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems easily.
words.ex_cn: 他能轻松处理困难的问题。
words.en: A deal is an agreement or arrangement, especially in business or politics, that is beneficial to all the parties involved.

words.ex: Some countries still use the death penalty.
words.ex_cn: 一些国家仍然使用死刑。
words.en: The death penalty is the legally authorized killing of someone as punishment for a crime.

words.ex: The death toll from the storm is 50.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴的死亡人数是50人。
words.en: The total number of deaths caused by a particular event or over a period of time.

words.ex: The defendant spoke calmly in court.
words.ex_cn: 被告在法庭上平静地发言。
words.en: A defendant is a person or entity against whom a criminal or civil action is brought in a court of law.

words.ex: The country has a budget deficit this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年这个国家的预算不足额。
words.en: A deficit is the amount by which something, especially a sum of money, is too small.

words.ex: The boy defied his parents by staying out late.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩因为熬夜不回家而违抗了父母。
words.en: If you defy someone or something, you refuse to obey them or you do something that they do not allow.

words.tr: phrase. 外交关系；外交联系
words.ex: The two countries established diplomatic ties in 1990.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家于1990年建立了外交关系。
words.en: A diplomatic tie refers to the formal relationship established between two countries, which involves the exchange of diplomats and the establishment of embassies in each other's territories.

words.ex: Sugar dissolves in water.
words.ex_cn: 糖在水中溶解。
words.en: If a substance dissolves in liquid or if you dissolve a substance, it becomes mixed with the liquid and disappears.

words.ex: He called the police because of domestic violence.
words.ex_cn: 他因为家庭暴力报了警。
words.en: Domestic violence refers to violent or aggressive behavior within the home, typically involving the violent abuse of a spouse or partner.

words.tr:
n. 鸽子；鸽派人物；温和派人物
v. 潜水；跳水；“dive”的过去式
words.ex: The dove flew over the garden.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子飞过花园。
words.en: A dove is a bird that is often used as a symbol of peace. It is known for its gentle nature and the soft cooing sound it makes.

words.ex: Drug abuse can lead to serious health problems.
words.ex_cn: 药物滥用会导致严重的健康问题。
words.en: The habitual taking of illegal drugs.

words.ex: The police finally captured the drug king after a long chase.
words.ex_cn: n. 经过长时间的追捕，警方终于抓住了那个毒枭。
words.en: A drug king is a person who controls a large part of the illegal drug trade.

words.tr: phrase. 酒后驾驶；醉酒驾驶
words.ex: Drunk driving is a serious offense that endangers lives.
words.ex_cn: 酒后驾驶是一种危及生命的严重违法行为。
words.en: The act of driving a vehicle while impaired by alcohol to the extent that one's mental faculties are significantly reduced.

words.tr: n. 杜马（俄罗斯的国家杜马）
words.ex: The Duma passed a new law on environmental protection.
words.ex_cn: 杜马通过了一项新的环境保护法。
words.en: The Duma is the lower house of the Federal Assembly of Russia, which is the country's legislative body.

words.tr:
n. 安逸；轻松；
v. 缓解；减轻；
words.ex: He enjoys the ease of living in a quiet village.
words.ex_cn: 他享受住在安静村庄里的安逸。
words.en: If you talk about the ease of a particular activity, you are referring to the way that it has been made easier to do, or to the fact that it is already easy to do. Ease is also a state of being comfortable and without worry or anxiety.

words.tr: phrase. 经济制裁；指一国或多国对另一国采取的经济上的惩罚措施，如贸易禁运、资产冻结等
words.ex: The country imposed economic sanctions on its neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 该国对其邻国实施了经济制裁。
words.en: Economic sanctions are commercial and financial penalties applied by one or more countries against a targeted country, group, or individual.

words.tr: phrase. 经济起飞，指一个国家或地区经济开始迅速增长并进入持续发展的阶段
words.ex: China's economic take-off began in the late 1970s.
words.ex_cn: 中国的经济起飞始于20世纪70年代末。
words.en: A period of rapid economic growth and development.

words.tr: phrase. 厄尔尼诺现象（太平洋赤道地区海水异常变暖的现象）
words.ex: El Nino causes heavy rain in South America.
words.ex_cn: 厄尔尼诺现象导致南美洲暴雨频发。
words.en: A climate pattern characterized by unusually warm ocean temperatures in the Equatorial Pacific, affecting global weather.

words.ex: The town uses solar panels to generate electric power.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇使用太阳能板来发电。
words.en: Electric power is the rate at which electrical energy is transferred by an electric circuit.

words.ex: We must eliminate the waste to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须消除浪费以保护环境。
words.en: To eliminate something, especially something you do not want or need, means to remove it completely.

words.tr:
n. 禁止贸易令；禁运
v. 禁止…的贸易；禁运
words.ex: The country placed an embargo on imported goods.
words.ex_cn: 该国对进口商品实施了禁运。
words.en: An embargo is an official order to stop trade with another country.

words.tr: phrase. 应征士兵；普通士兵（指非军官的军人）
words.ex: The enlisted man was commended for his bravery in battle.
words.ex_cn: 这名列兵因在战斗中的英勇表现而受到嘉奖。
words.en: An enlisted man is a man who is a member of the armed forces of a country and who is not an officer.

words.tr: n. 使节；特使；外交使节；
words.ex: The envoy met the president to discuss peace.
words.ex_cn: 使节会见了总统以讨论和平事宜。
words.en: An envoy is a representative sent by one government or leader to another, especially in order to carry out a particular task or to negotiate.

words.ex: The epidemic spread quickly across the country.
words.ex_cn: 这种流行病迅速蔓延到全国。
words.en: An epidemic is a large number of cases of an infectious disease occurring at the same time.

words.tr: phrase. 独家采访；仅由一家媒体进行的专访
words.ex: The celebrity gave an exclusive interview to the magazine.
words.ex_cn: 这位名人给这家杂志做了一次独家采访。
words.en: An exclusive interview is a special interview given to a particular journalist or media organization, not available to others.

words.ex: The city hosted an exposition last summer.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市去年夏天举办了一场博览会。
words.en: An exposition is a detailed explanation or description of an idea or theory. It can also refer to a large public exhibition of art or trade goods.

words.tr:
n. 眼睛；
v. 注视；审视；
words.ex: He hurt his eye in the game.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中伤了眼睛。
words.en: The organ of sight in humans and animals, typically one of a pair, which is sensitive to light and enables vision.

words.tr: phrase. 面对面的交谈；当面谈话
words.ex: The manager prefers face-to-face talk over phone calls.
words.ex_cn: 经理更喜欢面谈而不是电话交谈。
words.en: A direct conversation between two or more people in the same physical location.

words.ex: They use family planning to have fewer children.
words.ex_cn: 他们使用计划生育来少生孩子。
words.en: The practice of controlling the number of children one has and the intervals between their births, particularly by means of contraception or voluntary sterilization.

words.tr: n. 过错；故障；缺陷；断层；
words.ex: It was his fault that the car crashed.
words.ex_cn: 汽车撞车是他的过错。
words.en: A fault is a mistake or a weakness in something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 跳蚤市场；旧货市场
words.ex: I bought a used book at the flea market.
words.ex_cn: 我在跳蚤市场买了一本旧书。
words.en: A flea market is an outdoor market where people sell used goods, antiques, and collectibles.

words.tr: phrase. 飞行小队；机动小组（通常指警察中快速反应的特别行动小组）
words.ex: The flying squad was dispatched to the scene within minutes.
words.ex_cn: 飞行小组在几分钟内被派往现场。
words.en: A flying squad is a small group of people who are trained to respond quickly to emergencies or to perform tasks that require speed and efficiency.

words.ex: He saw his neighbor as a foe.
words.ex_cn: 他把邻居看作敌人。
words.en: A foe is someone who opposes or fights against another; an enemy.

words.tr: n. 诬陷，捏造；阴谋诡计
words.ex: They did a frame-up to make him look guilty.
words.ex_cn: 他们设局陷害他，让他看起来有罪。
words.en: A frame-up is a situation where someone is deliberately made to appear guilty of a crime they did not commit.

words.tr: phrase. 封面；头版（通常指报纸或杂志的第一页）
words.ex: The news is on the front page of the newspaper.
words.ex_cn: 这则新闻登在报纸的头版。
words.en: The first page of a newspaper or magazine, where the most important news is printed.

words.tr:
n. 紧握；掌握；控制；
v. 紧握；掌握；
words.ex: He has a strong grip on the handle.
words.ex_cn: 他紧紧握住把手。
words.en: To grip something means to hold it tightly. It can also mean to hold someone's attention completely.

words.ex: The guest of honor at the banquet was the mayor.
words.ex_cn: 宴会上的贵宾是市长。
words.en: The guest of honor is the most important guest at a social event or gathering.

words.tr: phrase. 客队，指在比赛或活动中前往对方场地参赛的队伍
words.ex: The guest team won the match.
words.ex_cn: 客队赢得了比赛。
words.en: A team that is playing away from home or is not the host of a particular event.

words.ex: The gunman ran away after the shooting.
words.ex_cn: 枪手在开枪后逃跑了。
words.en: A gunman is a man who uses a gun to commit a crime or to threaten people.

words.tr:
v. 中断；暂停；
n. 停顿下来；
words.ex: The storm halted the flight.
words.ex_cn: 风暴中断了航班。
words.en: to bring or come to a stop; a temporary or permanent stop

words.ex: A hawk flew over the field.
words.ex_cn: 一只鹰飞过田野。
words.en: A hawk is a bird of prey with a strong beak and sharp claws, known for its keen vision and swift flight. As a verb, to hawk means to sell goods aggressively, often in public places.

words.ex: He became addicted to heroin last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年对海洛因上瘾了。
words.en: Heroin is a highly addictive drug derived from morphine, which is itself obtained from the opium poppy. It is used illicitly for its euphoric effects.

words.tr: phrase. 畅销产品；热门商品
words.ex: The new smartphone was a hit product, selling millions of units in just a few months.
words.ex_cn: 这款新智能手机是一款畅销产品，仅在几个月内就售出了数百万台。
words.en: A product that is very popular and successful in the market.

words.tr: adj. 打了就跑的; 肇事逃逸的 n. 肇事逃逸
words.ex: The driver did a hit-and-run after crashing into the bike.
words.ex_cn: 撞上自行车后，司机逃逸了。
words.en: A hit-and-run is a traffic accident in which the driver who caused the accident drives away without stopping to help or to leave their name and address.

words.ex: The home team won the match last night.
words.ex_cn: 主队昨晚赢得了比赛。
words.en: The home team is the team that is playing a game at its own sports field or stadium, rather than at the sports field or stadium of the opposing team.

words.ex: The honor guard marched solemnly behind the casket.
words.ex_cn: 仪仗卫兵庄严地跟在灵柩后面行进。
words.en: A group of people, usually soldiers, who are chosen to perform ceremonial duties at important events.

words.ex: The robbers took a hostage during the bank robbery.
words.ex_cn: 劫匪在银行抢劫时抓了一名人质。
words.en: A hostage is someone who has been captured by a person or organization and who may be killed or injured if people do not do what that person or organization demands.

words.tr: phrase. 住房制度改革；改善住房条件的政策或措施
words.ex: The government is planning to implement a new housing reform to improve living conditions for low-income families.
words.ex_cn: 政府正计划实施新的住房改革，以改善低收入家庭的居住条件。
words.en: Housing reform refers to the process of improving the housing system, policies, and conditions to ensure better living standards for the population.

words.ex: The company decided to invest its idle money in the stock market.
words.ex_cn: 公司决定将其闲置资金投资于股市。
words.en: Money that is not being used to earn interest or profit, often kept in a bank account or as cash.

words.tr:
n. 影响力；冲击（力）；
v. 对…产生影响；
words.ex: The new law had a big impact on education.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对教育产生了重大影响。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.tr: phrase. 在另一相关进展中；在另一相关动态中
words.ex: In another related development, the company announced a new partnership.
words.ex_cn: phrase. 在另一个相关的进展中，公司宣布了一个新的合作伙伴关系。
words.en: Phrase. Used to introduce another piece of information that is related to the topic being discussed.

words.tr: phrase. 临时政府；过渡政府
words.ex: The interim government was established to oversee the transition of power.
words.ex_cn: 临时政府成立是为了监督权力的过渡。
words.en: A temporary government that is established to manage a country until a permanent government is elected.

words.tr: phrase. 邀请会面；邀请见面
words.ex: He got an invitation to meet his friend at the park.
words.ex_cn: 他收到了一封邀请，去公园见他的朋友。
words.en: A formal or official meeting or gathering for a specific purpose.

words.ex: The jet flew high above the clouds.
words.ex_cn: 喷气式飞机在云层上方飞行。
words.en: A jet is an aircraft that is powered by jet engines, allowing it to fly at high speeds. It can also refer to a stream of liquid or gas forced out of a small opening, or to travel by jet aircraft.

words.ex: He is jobless after losing his factory work.
words.ex_cn: 他失去工厂工作后失业了。
words.en: If someone is jobless, they do not have a job, although they would like one.

words.ex: He practices judo every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午练习柔道。
words.en: A sport of unarmed combat derived from jujitsu and intended to train the body and mind. It involves using holds and leverage to unbalance the opponent.

words.ex: He practices karate every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上练习空手道。
words.en: A Japanese martial art in which sharp blows and kicks are administered to pressure-sensitive points on the body of an opponent.

words.ex: The tournament uses a knock-out system to determine the winner.
words.ex_cn: 锦标赛使用淘汰制来决定胜者。
words.en: A competition system in which the loser of each match is immediately eliminated from the competition.

words.tr: phrase. 知识经济；以知识和信息为主要生产要素的经济形态
words.ex: The country is building a knowledge economy through education and technology.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家通过教育和技术建设知识经济。
words.en: An economy based on the production, distribution, and use of knowledge and information.

words.ex: He was laid-off due to company restructuring.
words.ex_cn: 由于公司重组，他被解雇了。
words.en: Dismissed from a job, especially temporarily because of a reduction in the workforce.

words.tr:
v. 发射；发起；启动；
n. 发射；投掷；启动；
words.ex: They will launch a rocket tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将发射一枚火箭。
words.en: To launch something means to send it into the air, space, or water, especially with a lot of force or effort, or to start an activity, event, or project.

words.tr: phrase. 男主角；主演；领衔演员
words.ex: He is the leading actor in the new movie.
words.ex_cn: 他是这部新电影的男主角。
words.en: The main actor in a play, film, or television show.

words.tr:
n. 租契；
v. 出租；
words.ex: He signed a lease for the apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他签了公寓的租契。
words.en: A lease is a legal agreement by which the owner of a building, a piece of land, or something such as a car allows someone else to use it for a period of time in return for money.

words.ex: We waited in the hotel lobby for our friend.
words.ex_cn: 我们在酒店的大厅里等我们的朋友。
words.en: A lobby is a large room or hall in a building, often used for meetings or as a waiting area. As a verb, to lobby means to try to influence politicians or officials on a particular issue.

words.tr: phrase. 名人；显赫人物；有影响力的人
words.ex: He is considered a man of mark in the field of finance.
words.ex_cn: 他被认为是金融领域的名人。
words.en: A man of mark is someone who is distinguished or prominent in a particular field.

words.tr:
v. 屠杀 
n. 大屠杀
words.ex: The soldiers committed a massacre in the village.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们在村庄里进行了大屠杀。
words.en: The indiscriminate killing of a large number of people.

words.tr:
n. 媒介；方法；
adj. 中等的；适中的；
words.ex: TV is a popular medium for advertising.
words.ex_cn: 电视是一种流行的广告媒介。
words.en: A medium is a method or way of expressing something.

words.ex: The old man asked for mercy killing because he was in great pain.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人因为痛苦不堪，请求安乐死。
words.en: The act of killing someone painlessly, especially someone suffering from an incurable disease; euthanasia.

words.tr: n. 穆斯林；伊斯兰教信徒；
words.ex: He is a muslim who prays five times a day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名每天祈祷五次的穆斯林。
words.en: A Muslim is a person who follows the religion of Islam.

words.ex: The national anthem was played before the start of the game.
words.ex_cn: 比赛开始前演奏了国歌。
words.en: A national anthem is a patriotic musical composition that is officially recognized by a country's government as the state's official song.

words.ex: The motion was defeated by a negative vote.
words.ex_cn: 该动议因反对票而被否决。
words.en: A vote indicating opposition to a proposal or motion.

words.ex: The news agency reported the latest political developments.
words.ex_cn: 这家新闻机构报道了最新的政治发展。
words.en: A news agency is an organization that gathers news and supplies it to newspapers, magazines, television, and radio stations.

words.ex: The news briefing was canceled today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的新闻简报被取消了。
words.en: A news briefing is a meeting in which officials give information to journalists about a particular issue or event.

words.tr: phrase. 新闻发布会；记者招待会
words.ex: The president held a news conference to address the recent scandals.
words.ex_cn: 总统召开了记者招待会，以回应最近的丑闻。
words.en: A news conference is a meeting organized for the purposes of distributing information to the media and answering questions from reporters.

words.tr: phrase. 新闻快讯；突发新闻
words.ex: A news flash interrupted the regular programming.
words.ex_cn: 一条最新新闻打断了正常的节目播出。
words.en: A news flash is a brief report on an important piece of news that is given in the middle of a television or radio program.

words.ex: They will nominate her for the award.
words.ex_cn: 他们将提名她获得这个奖项。
words.en: If someone is nominated for a job or position, their name is formally suggested as a candidate for it.

words.ex: He is the nominee for best actor.
words.ex_cn: 他是最佳男演员的提名人。
words.en: A nominee is someone who is proposed for an official position or for an honour or award.

words.tr: phrase. /adv. 待命状态；随时可用；备用
words.ex: The ambulance was on standby during the marathon.
words.ex_cn: 救护车在马拉松比赛期间处于待命状态。
words.en: If someone or something is on standby, they are ready to be used or to take action if they are needed.

words.tr: phrase. 现场直播；实况广播
words.ex: The news channel provided on-the-spot broadcasting of the presidential inauguration.
words.ex_cn: 新闻频道对总统就职典礼进行了现场直播。
words.en: The live transmission of an event as it happens, especially on television or radio.

words.tr: phrase. 民意调查；民意测验；舆论调查
words.ex: The newspaper did an opinion poll about the election.
words.ex_cn: 报纸就选举做了一项民意调查。
words.en: An opinion poll is a survey of public opinion from a particular sample.

words.tr: n. 严酷的考验；痛苦的经历；煎熬
words.ex: He went through a long ordeal before he found peace.
words.ex_cn: 他在找到平静之前经历了一段漫长的磨难。
words.en: An ordeal is a very unpleasant and prolonged experience.

words.ex: The outbreak of the flu surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 流感的爆发让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: An outbreak of something unpleasant, such as violence or a disease, is a sudden occurrence of it.

words.ex: The factory's output increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂上个月的产量增加了。
words.en: The amount of something produced by a person, machine, or industry.

words.ex: The overseas student lives in a dormitory.
words.ex_cn: 这位留学生住在宿舍里。
words.en: A student who comes from a foreign country to study in another country.

words.tr: phrase. 压倒性多数；绝大多数
words.ex: The overwhelming majority of students passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 绝大多数学生通过了考试。
words.en: An overwhelming majority refers to a very large majority, especially in a vote or decision-making process.

words.ex: The two countries made a pact to stop fighting.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家达成了一项停止战斗的协议。
words.en: A pact is a formal agreement between two or more people, organizations, or governments to do a particular thing or to help each other.

words.ex: The parliament passed a new law about education.
words.ex_cn: 国会通过了一项关于教育的新法律。
words.en: A parliament is a legislative body of government, typically composed of elected representatives, that is responsible for making laws and representing the interests of the people.

words.ex: A passer-by helped the old man cross the street.
words.ex_cn: 一位路人帮老人过马路。
words.en: A passer-by is a person who is walking past something, especially when something unusual is happening.

words.tr: phrase. 上车直接向司机付费的公交车；投币式公交
words.ex: In some cities, you can find pay-to-the-driver buses that allow passengers to pay directly to the bus driver.
words.ex_cn: 在一些城市，你可以找到上车付费的公交车，乘客可以直接向司机支付车费。
words.en: A bus system where passengers pay the fare directly to the bus driver upon boarding.

words.ex: The two countries have maintained a peaceful co-existence for decades.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家几十年来一直保持着和平共处。
words.en: Peaceful co-existence refers to the state or condition of living together in peace and harmony, without conflict or hostility, especially among nations or groups with differing ideologies or interests.

words.tr: phrase. 维和部队；维持和平部队
words.ex: The peace-keeping force was deployed to the conflict zone to prevent further escalation.
words.ex_cn: 维和部队被部署到冲突地区，以防止局势进一步升级。
words.en: A peace-keeping force is a group of soldiers or police officers who are sent to a place where there is conflict, in order to try to prevent more violence.

words.tr: phrase. 黄金收视时段；观众最多的观看时间
words.ex: The peak viewing time for this show is between 8 and 10 pm.
words.ex_cn: 这个节目的黄金时间是在晚上8点到10点之间。
words.en: The period of the day when the largest number of people are watching television, typically in the evening.

words.ex: The pedestrian crossed the street at the zebra crossing.
words.ex_cn: 行人在斑马线处过马路。
words.en: A pedestrian is a person who is walking in a city, town, or village, especially along a pavement or in a pedestrian area.

words.tr: phrase. 养老保险；退休金保险
words.ex: The company offers pension insurance to its employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司为其员工提供退休金保险。
words.en: Pension insurance is a type of insurance policy that provides a person with a pension, a series of payments made at regular intervals after retirement.

words.ex: The pentagon is a five-sided shape.
words.ex_cn: 五边形是一个五边的形状。
words.en: A pentagon is a five-sided polygon.

words.ex: Free lunch is a perk of this job.
words.ex_cn: 免费午餐是这份工作的一个额外补贴。
words.en: If someone perks up or if something perks them up, they become more cheerful or lively.

words.ex: The dog fell into a deep pit.
words.ex_cn: 狗掉进了一个深坑。
words.en: A pit is a large hole in the ground, either natural or as a result of digging. It can also refer to a hollow or indentation in a surface, or a place where something is extracted, such as a mine. As a verb, to pit means to set someone or something in competition or to make a hollow or indentation in a surface.

words.ex: He made a plea for help.
words.ex_cn: 他恳求帮助。
words.en: A plea is a request or an appeal made in an urgent or emotional manner, or a statement made by someone in a court of law in which they say whether they are guilty of a crime or not.

words.ex: He made a pledge to help the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他做出了帮助穷人的保证。
words.en: A pledge is a serious promise or agreement, especially one made publicly or officially. It can also refer to something given as security for the fulfillment of a contract or the payment of a debt.

words.tr:
v. 投入；跳入
n. 跳进；骤降
words.ex: He plunged into the cold water.
words.ex_cn: 他跳进了冰冷的水里。
words.en: If something or someone plunges in a particular direction, especially into water, they fall, rush, or throw themselves in that direction.

words.tr: abbr. 下午；午后；“post meridiem”的缩写
words.ex: The meeting is at 3 pm.
words.ex_cn: 会议在下午3点。
words.en: PM is used to refer to the time from 12 noon to 12 midnight. It is an abbreviation for 'post meridiem', which is Latin for 'after midday'.

words.ex: The prime minister gave a speech yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 总理昨天发表了一次演讲。
words.en: The head of an elected government; the principal minister of a sovereign or state.

words.ex: The poll showed that most people support the new law.
words.ex_cn: 这项民意调查表明，大多数人支持这项新法律。
words.en: A poll is a survey in which people are asked their opinions about something, usually in order to find out how popular something is or what people intend to do in the future.

words.ex: The pope speaks to millions of people every year.
words.ex_cn: 教皇每年向数百万人讲话。
words.en: The Pope is the bishop of Rome and the leader of the worldwide Catholic Church.

words.tr: phrase. 贫困地区；极度贫困的区域
words.ex: The government is implementing new policies to aid the poverty-stricken areas.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在实施新政策以援助贫困地区。
words.en: An area characterized by extreme poverty.

words.ex: The entire city was plunged into darkness due to a power failure.
words.ex_cn: 由于停电，整个城市陷入了黑暗。
words.en: A power failure is a period of time when the electricity supply to a building or area is interrupted.

words.ex: The movie's premiere was held last night.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的首映昨晚举行。
words.en: The first public performance of a play, film, or other form of entertainment.

words.tr: phrase. 新闻发布会；新闻简报会
words.ex: The government held a press briefing to announce the new policy.
words.ex_cn: 政府举行新闻发布会，宣布新政策。
words.en: A press briefing is a meeting in which officials or politicians give the press information about something.

words.tr: phrase. 记者团；新闻采访团
words.ex: The press corps was waiting for the president's statement.
words.ex_cn: 记者团正在等待总统的声明。
words.en: A group of journalists who report on news events, especially those who follow a particular person or organization.

words.tr:
n. 新闻界；出版社；
v. 按；压；
words.ex: The press reported the news quickly.
words.ex_cn: 新闻界迅速报道了这则新闻。
words.en: To press something is to push it firmly, often with your fingers or hand, in order to operate a device or machine, or to make something flat or smooth. It can also mean to urge someone to do something or to make a strong demand for something.

words.tr: phrase. 新闻发言官；新闻发言人
words.ex: The press spokesman announced the new policy at the conference.
words.ex_cn: 新闻发言人在会议上宣布了新政策。
words.en: A press spokesman is a person who is employed to speak on behalf of an organization or government to the press and media.

words.tr: phrase. 颁奖仪式；颁奖典礼
words.ex: The prize-awarding ceremony was held in the grand hall.
words.ex_cn: 颁奖仪式在大礼堂举行。
words.en: An event or function where prizes are awarded to the winners.

words.tr:
n. 探测器；
v. 探查；
words.ex: The probe sent back photos from Mars.
words.ex_cn: 探测器从火星传回了照片。
words.en: If you probe into something, you ask questions or try to discover facts about it. A probe is also a long thin instrument that doctors and dentists use to examine parts of the body.

words.tr:
n. 提示；
v. 促使；
adj. 迅速的；准时的；
words.ex: The teacher gave a prompt to help students start writing.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了一个提示，帮助学生开始写作。
words.en: If you prompt someone when they stop speaking, you encourage or help them to continue. If you are prompt to do something, you do it without delay or you are not late.

words.ex: The two countries signed a protocol to stop the war.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了一项停止战争的协议。
words.en: A protocol is a set of rules or a system of rules about the correct way to act in formal situations.

words.ex: He has been a dedicated public servant for over 20 years.
words.ex_cn: 他作为一名尽职的公务员已经服务了20多年。
words.en: A public servant is a person who works for the government or for a public organization, especially in a role that involves helping the public.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a questionnaire about our habits.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们一份关于我们习惯的问卷。
words.en: A questionnaire is a written list of questions which are answered by a lot of people in order to provide information for a report or a survey.

words.tr: phrase. 速冻食品；经快速冷冻处理的食品
words.ex: Quick-frozen food is a convenient option for busy people.
words.ex_cn: 速冻食品是忙碌人士的便捷选择。
words.en: Food that has been rapidly frozen to preserve its freshness and nutritional value.

words.ex: He decided to quit smoking last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年决定戒烟。
words.en: If you quit, or quit something, you stop doing it or leave it.

words.ex: Racial discrimination is a serious problem in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 种族歧视是许多国家的一个严重问题。
words.en: Racial discrimination refers to the unfair treatment of individuals based on their race or ethnicity, often resulting in disparities in opportunities, resources, and treatment.

words.ex: He burst into rage when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个消息时，他勃然大怒。
words.en: Rage is a feeling of intense anger that is difficult to control.

words.ex: The soldiers raided the enemy camp at night.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们在夜间突袭了敌人的营地。
words.en: A raid is a sudden attack on a place by soldiers, police, or other officials, in order to search for something or to arrest someone.

words.ex: They have a reciprocal agreement to help each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们有一个互相帮助的互惠协议。
words.en: A reciprocal action or agreement involves two people or groups who do the same thing to each other or agree to help each other in a similar way.

words.ex: I reckon it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我认为明天会下雨。
words.en: If you reckon that something is true, you think that it is true.

words.tr: phrase. 隆重欢迎；红毯礼遇；盛大接待
words.ex: The mayor gave the visiting president a red-carpet welcome.
words.ex_cn: 市长为来访的总统举行了红地毯式欢迎。
words.en: A very warm and grand welcome, often involving a literal red carpet.

words.tr: phrase. 最新最热的新闻；爆炸性新闻；极度热门资讯
words.ex: The red-hot news of the day is the presidential election.
words.ex_cn: 当天最热门的新闻是总统选举。
words.en: The term 'red-hot news' refers to the latest or most exciting news that has just been reported or discovered.

words.tr: phrase. 大喜之日；特别值得纪念或庆祝的日子
words.ex: Her graduation day was a red-letter day for the whole family.
words.ex_cn: 她的毕业日对整个家庭来说都是一个值得纪念的日子。
words.en: A red-letter day is a day that is very important or memorable.

words.ex: The extra chair is redundant because we have enough seats.
words.ex_cn: 这把额外的椅子是多余的，因为我们已经有足够的座位了。
words.en: If you are made redundant, your employer tells you to leave because your job is no longer necessary or because there is no more work for you.

words.ex: After a brief layoff, she secured re-employment with the same company.
words.ex_cn: 经过短暂的解雇后，她在同一家公司重新获得了工作。
words.en: The act of being employed again, especially after a period of unemployment.

words.ex: He reject the job offer.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝了这份工作邀请。
words.en: If you reject something such as a proposal, a request, or an offer, you do not accept it or you do not agree to it.

words.tr: v. 辞职；使…顺从于（做）某事；
words.ex: He decided to resign from his job.
words.ex_cn: 他决定辞去工作。
words.en: If you resign from a job or position, you formally announce that you are leaving it.

words.ex: The teacher will revoke his privilege to use the computer.
words.ex_cn: 老师将撤销他使用电脑的权限。
words.en: If someone in authority revokes something such as a law, license, or agreement, they cancel it.

words.tr:
n. 规则；统治；
v. 统治；
words.ex: The teacher made a new rule for homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师制定了一个新的作业规则。
words.en: A rule is a statement telling people what they should do in order to achieve success or a benefit of some kind.

words.tr:
n. 袋子；
v. 劫掠；
words.ex: He carried the apples in a burlap sack.
words.ex_cn: 他把苹果装在一个麻布袋里。
words.en: A sack is a large bag made of rough woven material, used for storing or carrying goods. It can also refer to the act of dismissing someone from employment or the act of looting a place.

words.tr:
n. 批准；允许；认可；制裁；处罚
v. 批准；认可；制裁；处罚
words.ex: The company got official sanction to open a new branch.
words.ex_cn: 该公司获得了开设新分公司的正式批准。
words.en: A sanction is a penalty for disobeying a law or rule, or an official permission or approval for an action.

words.ex: The scandal made the news last week.
words.ex_cn: 这起丑闻上周上了新闻。
words.en: A scandal is a situation or event that is thought to be shocking and immoral and that everyone knows about.

words.ex: The senate voted to pass the new law.
words.ex_cn: 参议院投票通过了这项新法律。
words.en: The Senate is the smaller and more important of the two parts of the parliament in some countries, for example in the United States and Australia.

words.tr: v. 杀死；杀害；残害；宰杀
words.ex: He slayed the monster in the dark forest.
words.ex_cn: 他在黑暗的森林里杀死了怪物。
words.en: To kill someone or something in a violent way.

words.ex: The price of oil soared last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月石油价格骤升。
words.en: To rise or increase dramatically in amount or level.

words.ex: He squeezed into the small seat.
words.ex_cn: 他挤进了小座位里。
words.en: To squeeze something means to press it firmly, usually with your fingers or hands, often to get liquid out of it or to make it smaller.

words.ex: The negotiations ended in a standoff.
words.ex_cn: 谈判以僵局结束。
words.en: A standoff is a situation in which neither side in a conflict or dispute is willing to back down or compromise, resulting in a deadlock.

words.ex: There is strife between the two neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 这两个邻居之间有争执。
words.en: Strife is angry or violent conflict between two people or groups.

words.ex: He will sue the company for damages.
words.ex_cn: 他将起诉这家公司要求赔偿。
words.en: To sue means to start a legal case against someone, usually to claim money from them because they have caused you harm or loss.

words.ex: The climbers reached the summit of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 登山者到达了山顶。
words.en: The highest point of a hill or mountain; a meeting between heads of government.

words.ex: There was a surge in sales during the holiday season.
words.ex_cn: 假期期间销量激增。
words.en: If something surges, it increases suddenly and greatly, after having been steady or only small in size or amount.

words.tr:
v. 诈骗；骗取
n. 诈取；骗局
words.ex: He tried to swindle money from old people.
words.ex_cn: 他试图欺骗老人的钱。
words.en: To swindle means to deceive someone in order to get money or possessions from them dishonestly.

words.tr:
v. 转换；
n. 开关；
words.ex: He switched off the light before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前把灯关掉了。
words.en: A switch is a small control for an electrical device which you use to turn the device on or off.

words.ex: The hawk made a sudden swoop to catch the mouse.
words.ex_cn: 老鹰突然俯冲下来抓老鼠。
words.en: To move very quickly and easily through the air, especially down from a height in order to attack.

words.tr:
n. 桌子；表格；台子；
v. 搁置；
words.ex: He put his books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在桌子上。
words.en: A table is a piece of furniture with a flat top that you put things on or use to do things such as eat, write, or work.

words.tr: n. 会谈；‘“talk”的复数； v. 谈话；
words.ex: The talks between the two countries ended peacefully.
words.ex_cn: 两国之间的会谈和平结束。
words.en: Talks are formal discussions or negotiations between two or more parties, often with the aim of reaching an agreement or solving a problem.

words.ex: He taunted his brother for losing the game.
words.ex_cn: 他奚落弟弟比赛输了。
words.en: If someone taunts you, they say unkind or insulting things to you, especially about your weaknesses or failures.

words.tr: phrase. 任职期限；担任职务的期间
words.ex: The tenure of office for the president is four years.
words.ex_cn: 总统的任期为四年。
words.en: The period during which an official holds a position or office.

words.tr:
v. 阻挠；妨碍；挫败
n. 横坐板
words.ex: The rain thwarted our picnic plans.
words.ex_cn: 雨水破坏了我们的野餐计划。
words.en: If you thwart someone or thwart their plans, you prevent them from doing or getting what they want.

words.ex: He fastened the ties around his neck.
words.ex_cn: 他把领结系在脖子上。
words.en: Ties refer to the connections or relationships between people, groups, or things, as well as the narrow piece of cloth worn around the neck, typically by men, under the collar of a shirt.

words.tr: phrase. 头条新闻；最重要的新闻
words.ex: The top news of the day was the president's speech on national security.
words.ex_cn: 当天的头条新闻是总统关于国家安全的讲话。
words.en: The most important or recent news stories.

words.tr:
n. 顶；顶部；顶端；
adj. 最高的；极棒的；
v. 胜过；超过；
words.ex: The top of the mountain is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 山顶上覆盖着雪。
words.en: The highest or uppermost point, part, or surface of something.

words.ex: The tornado destroyed the small house.
words.ex_cn: 龙卷风摧毁了那座小房子。
words.en: A tornado is a violent windstorm characterized by a twisting, funnel-shaped cloud.

words.tr: phrase. 交通堵塞；交通阻塞
words.ex: The traffic tie-up lasted for two hours.
words.ex_cn: 交通堵塞持续了两个小时。
words.en: A situation in which vehicles are unable to move forward because the road is blocked, often due to an accident or heavy traffic.

words.tr:
v. 触发；引起；发动；
n. 诱因；触发；
words.ex: The loud noise triggered the alarm.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音触发了警报。
words.en: A trigger is a device that activates a mechanism when it is pulled or pressed. It can also refer to something that causes a particular reaction or development.

words.ex: He always keeps his garden trim and neat.
words.ex_cn: 他总是把花园打理得整洁有序。
words.en: To trim something means to make it tidier or more level by cutting a small amount off it.

words.tr: n. 停战（协定）；休战（协定）
words.ex: The two sides agreed to a truce.
words.ex_cn: 双方同意停火。
words.en: A truce is an agreement between enemies or opponents to stop fighting or arguing for a certain time.

words.ex: The tsunami destroyed the village near the sea.
words.ex_cn: 海啸摧毁了海边的村庄。
words.en: A tsunami is a very large ocean wave caused by an underwater earthquake or volcanic eruption.

words.ex: He got a vaccine last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周打了疫苗。
words.en: A vaccine is a substance containing a virus or bacterium in a form that is not harmful, given to a person or animal to prevent them from getting the disease that the virus or bacterium causes.

words.tr: phrase. 无车辆通行的步行街或散步道
words.ex: The city has introduced a vehicle-free promenade to encourage walking and cycling.
words.ex_cn: n. 该市引入了禁止车辆通行的步行区，以鼓励步行和骑自行车。
words.en: A pedestrian area where vehicles are not allowed, designed to encourage walking and cycling.

words.tr:
n. 否决；否决权
v. 否决
words.ex: The president used his veto to stop the law.
words.ex_cn: 总统行使否决权阻止了这项法律。
words.en: If someone in authority vetoes something, they forbid it, or they stop it from being put into action.

words.ex: They vote down the proposal in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他们在会议上投票否决了这个提议。
words.en: To reject or defeat a proposal, motion, or candidate by a majority of votes.

words.tr:
n. 誓言；誓约
v. 发誓；起誓
words.ex: He made a vow to quit smoking.
words.ex_cn: 他发誓戒烟。
words.en: A vow is a serious promise or decision to do something.

words.tr: n. 罢工；退席（以示抗议）
words.ex: The workers staged a walkout to protest the unfair labor practices.
words.ex_cn: 工人们举行罢工，抗议不公平的劳工行为。
words.en: A walkout is a strike or a protest in which people leave a place, such as their workplace or a meeting, to show their disapproval or to demand something.

words.ex: The two companies will wed next month.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司下个月将合并。
words.en: To marry someone; to join in marriage.

words.ex: The doctor will weigh the baby at the clinic.
words.ex_cn: 医生将在诊所称量婴儿的体重。
words.en: To weigh something means to measure how heavy it is, usually by using scales. It can also mean to consider something carefully before making a decision.

words.tr: adj. 顺利的；宽裕的；有钱的
words.ex: He comes from a well-off family and never worries about money.
words.ex_cn: 他来自一个顺利的家庭，从不为钱发愁。
words.en: Someone who is well-off is rich enough to be able to do and buy most of the things that they want.

words.tr: adj. 富裕的；富有的；有钱的
words.ex: The well-to-do family bought a big house.
words.ex_cn: 这个富裕的家庭买了一栋大房子。
words.en: Someone who is well-to-do is wealthy and has a high standard of living.

words.ex: The storm left only wreckage on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 风暴在海滩上只留下了残骸。
words.en: The remains of something that has been badly damaged or destroyed.

words.tr:
v. 生产；获利；
n. 产量；
words.ex: This farm yields a lot of wheat each year.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场每年生产大量小麦。
words.en: If you yield to someone or something, you stop resisting them. If a tree or plant yields fruit or flowers, it produces them.

chapters.name: 附录二:完形及词汇部分常用搭配

words.tr: phrase. 是…的原因；解释；负责；（数量或比例上）占
words.ex: The rain can account for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 下雨是延误的原因。
words.en: If a particular thing accounts for a part or proportion of something, that part or proportion consists of that thing, or is used or produced by it.

words.ex: He adapts to new rules quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快适应新规则。
words.en: If you adapt to a new situation or adapt yourself to it, you change your ideas or behaviour in order to deal with it successfully.

words.tr: phrase. 在……方面同意；在……上达成一致
words.ex: They agree in their opinions about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他们对这部电影的看法一致。
words.en: To reach a mutual decision or consensus.

words.tr: phrase. 就……达成一致；同意某事
words.ex: They agree upon the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他们同意这个计划。
words.en: If people agree upon something, they reach a mutual understanding or consensus about it.

words.tr: phrase. 赞同； 同意； 适合于
words.ex: I agree with you on this point.
words.ex_cn: 我同意你的这个观点。
words.en: to have the same opinion as someone else; to accept a suggestion or idea

words.tr: phrase. 考虑到；体谅；允许有；留出
words.ex: The plan allows for extra time if needed.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划为需要时留出了额外的时间。
words.en: To make provision or plans for something; to take into consideration.

words.ex: The savings amount to $500.
words.ex_cn: 这些储蓄加起来是500美元。
words.en: If something amounts to a particular total, all the parts of it add up to that total. If an idea, feeling, or action amounts to something, it has the same effect or importance as that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 回嘴；顶嘴；反驳（通常指对上级无礼地回应）
words.ex: The student got in trouble because he dared to answer back to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 这个学生因为胆敢顶嘴老师而惹上了麻烦。
words.en: To reply rudely or defiantly to someone, especially someone in authority.

words.tr:
v. 回答；回应；
n. 回答；答案；
words.ex: He answered the question quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回答了问题。
words.en: An answer is something that you say or write when you reply to a question or remark.

words.ex: He is anything but lazy.
words.ex_cn: 他绝不是懒惰的。
words.en: You use anything but in expressions such as anything but quiet and anything but happy to emphasize that something is not the case.

words.ex: This rule applies to all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则适用于所有学生。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.ex: He asks for help when he is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 当他遇到困难时，他会寻求帮助。
words.en: To request something; to express a desire for something.

words.ex: As regards homework, I finish it every day.
words.ex_cn: 关于作业，我每天都完成。
words.en: You use 'as regards' to indicate the subject that is being talked or written about.

words.ex: He didn't study hard, as a result, he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他没有努力学习，结果考试不及格。
words.en: used to introduce the consequence or effect of a particular situation or event

words.tr: phrase. 由于…的结果；起因；经；因
words.ex: He was late as a result of the bus breaking down.
words.ex_cn: 由于公交车坏了，他迟到了。
words.en: Because of something that has happened.

words.ex: He is a teacher, and as such, he must be patient.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名老师，同样地，他必须有耐心。
words.en: You use as such after a noun to indicate that you are considering that thing on its own, separately from other things.

words.ex: He likes coffee, and he likes tea as well.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢咖啡，也喜欢茶。
words.en: In addition to something else; also.

words.tr: 短语. 一眼就能看出； glance 表示一瞥，at a glance 意为 glance 一下就能明白，即立刻理解或看出
words.ex: I can understand the chart at a glance.
words.ex_cn: 我一眼就能看懂这个图表。
words.en: If you see something at a glance, you see or recognize it immediately, often without looking carefully.

words.ex: He is accustomed to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他习惯于早起。
words.en: If you are accustomed to something, you are used to it and it is normal for you.

words.tr:
adv. 相同地；相像地；
adj. 相同的；相像的；
words.ex: They dress alike.
words.ex_cn: 他们穿得一样。
words.en: If two or more things are alike, they are similar in some way.

words.ex: He was late because of the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他因为公交车而迟到了。
words.en: You use 'because of' to introduce the reason or explanation for something.

words.ex: He is confronted with a difficult problem.
words.ex_cn: 他面临一个困难的问题。
words.en: To be faced with or opposed by something or someone, typically in a challenging or hostile manner.

words.tr: adj. 一致的；始终如一的；
words.ex: His answers are consistent with the data.
words.ex_cn: 他的答案与数据一致。
words.en: Someone who is consistent always behaves in the same way, has the same attitudes towards people or things, or achieves the same level of success in something.

words.tr: adj. 命中注定的； v. 注定；“doom”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The doomed ship sank in the storm.
words.ex_cn: 那艘命中注定的船在风暴中沉没了。
words.en: If something is doomed, it is certain to fail or be destroyed.

words.ex: Two plus two is equal to four.
words.ex_cn: 二加二等于四。
words.en: If one thing is equal to another, they are the same in size, number, standard, or value.

words.ex: The lab is equipped with new computers.
words.ex_cn: 实验室配备了新的电脑。
words.en: To be provided with the necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He wants to familiarize himself with the new software.
words.ex_cn: 他想熟悉这个新软件。
words.en: To familiarize someone with something means to give them knowledge or experience of it.

words.ex: He felt guilty for lying to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他因为对朋友撒谎而感到有罪。
words.en: If you feel guilty, you feel unhappy because you believe that you have done something wrong or have failed to do something which you should have done.

words.tr: phrase. v. 与……保持同步；与……协调一致
words.ex: It's important to be in step with the latest trends in technology.
words.ex_cn: 与最新的技术趋势保持一致是很重要的。
words.en: To be in agreement or harmony with something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 处于良好（或特定）状态；健康状况良好
words.ex: He is in condition to run the race.
words.ex_cn: 他状态良好，可以参加比赛。
words.en: In a particular state or situation, especially a medical one.

words.ex: The table is made from wood.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是用木头做的。
words.en: Created or produced using a particular material or substance as the main component.

words.ex: The team is made up of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: If something is made up of particular things or people, it consists of those things or people.

words.tr: 短语动词. 身体状况不佳；健康状态不好
words.ex: He is out of condition because he stopped exercising.
words.ex_cn: 他因为停止锻炼而体能下降。
words.en: If someone is out of condition, they are not physically fit.

words.ex: This problem is related to math.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题与数学有关。
words.en: To be connected or associated with something or someone.

words.ex: This topic is relevant to our project.
words.ex_cn: 这个话题与我们的项目相关。
words.en: To be connected with what is happening or being discussed.

words.tr: phrase. 类似于； 与 ... 相似
words.ex: This apple is similar to that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果和那个很相似。
words.en: If one thing is similar to another, or if two things are similar, they have features that are the same.

words.ex: He is suited to teaching children.
words.ex_cn: 他适合教孩子。
words.en: To be appropriate or well-matched for a particular purpose, situation, or person.

words.ex: He used to play soccer every day.
words.ex_cn: 他过去每天踢足球。
words.en: If something used to be done or used to be the case, it was done regularly in the past or was the case in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 超出……的范围；无法触及；够不着
words.ex: The remote island is beyond the reach of modern communication.
words.ex_cn: 这个偏远的岛屿超出了现代通讯的控制范围。
words.en: If something is beyond the reach of someone or something, it is impossible for them to achieve, get, or use it.

words.tr: phrase. 突然离开； 突然挣脱；决裂； 退出
words.ex: He broke away from the group and ran home.
words.ex_cn: 他突然离开团队，跑回家了。
words.en: To leave or escape from a person, group, or situation that controls or restricts you.

words.tr: phrase. 停止运转；出故障；分解；感情失控
words.ex: The machine broke down yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器昨天坏了。
words.en: If a machine or vehicle breaks down, it stops working. If a discussion, relationship, or system breaks down, it fails because of a problem or disagreement.

words.tr: phrase. 中断；突然停止；断绝（关系）；休息一会
words.ex: He broke off the conversation when the phone rang.
words.ex_cn: 电话响时，他中断了对话。
words.en: To suddenly stop doing something, especially speaking.

words.tr: phrase. 打碎；分裂；解体；结束；期终放假
words.ex: He broke up the ice with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子把冰打碎了。
words.en: To end a relationship or to disintegrate into pieces.

words.ex: I met my old friend by chance at the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 我在超市碰巧遇到了我的老朋友。
words.en: If something happens by chance, it happens without being planned or intended.

words.tr: phrase. 通过经验；凭借经历
words.ex: He learned to fix cars by experience.
words.ex_cn: 他通过经验学会了修车。
words.en: As a result of having lived through or encountered something.

words.ex: He knows the poem by heart.
words.ex_cn: 他把这首诗背得滚瓜烂熟。
words.en: If you know something by heart, you have learned it so well that you can remember it perfectly.

words.ex: By comparison with last year, the company's profits have increased significantly.
words.ex_cn: 与去年相比，公司的利润有了显著增长。
words.en: Used to indicate the act of comparing one thing with another.

words.ex: He runs fast, in comparison with his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，与他哥哥相比。
words.en: Used to say that something is being considered in relation to something else, especially to show how they are different or similar.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吁；号召；要求；接（人）
words.ex: The situation calls for immediate action.
words.ex_cn: 这种情况需要立即采取行动。
words.en: If you call for something, you demand that it should happen.

words.tr: phrase. 叫（某人）进来；召来；来访
words.ex: He called in a doctor for his sick son.
words.ex_cn: 他为生病的儿子请了一位医生。
words.en: To request someone's presence or participation, especially by telephone.

words.tr: phrase. v. 叫来；把…叫过来；点名
words.ex: He called over to his friend across the street.
words.ex_cn: 他向街对面的朋友大声招呼。
words.en: To summon someone to come to a place, especially by calling their name.

words.ex: The teacher asked the student to call out the answer.
words.ex_cn: 老师让那个学生大声说出答案。
words.en: To shout or speak loudly in order to get someone's attention, or to summon someone to come or to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 拜访；要求；呼吁；号召
words.ex: I will call upon my grandmother this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这个周末我会去拜访我的祖母。
words.en: To call upon someone is to ask them to do something or to use something that they can offer.

words.ex: He ran fast to catch up with his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便追上他的朋友。
words.en: To reach someone or something that is ahead of you, or to make up for lost time or progress.

words.tr: phrase. 清理；澄清；解决；放晴
words.ex: He helped to clear up the toys after playtime.
words.ex_cn: 他帮忙在玩完后收拾玩具。
words.en: To remove things that are causing a mess or obstruction; to explain something that was unclear; for the weather to become fine.

words.ex: His opinion coincides with mine.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点与我的一致。
words.en: To happen at the same time as something else or to be the same or very similar.

words.tr: phrase. 苏醒；到达；总计；突然想起
words.ex: He came to after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后他醒了过来。
words.en: If someone comes to, they regain consciousness after being unconscious. It can also mean to reach a particular state or condition, or to be involved in something.

words.ex: He compares his score with his friend's score.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己的分数和朋友的分数做比较。
words.en: To examine or look for the difference between two or more things.

words.ex: The team consists of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: If something consists of particular things or people, it is made up of them.

words.ex: The kids are watching the countdown to New Year.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在观看新年的倒计时。
words.en: A countdown is the counting aloud of numbers in reverse order before something happens, especially before a spacecraft is launched.

words.tr: phrase. （音乐开始前打拍子）开始计数；把…包括在内
words.ex: The teacher will count in before the choir sings.
words.ex_cn: 合唱团唱歌前，老师会先打拍子计数。
words.en: To include someone in a plan or activity.

words.ex: I can count on my brother to help me.
words.ex_cn: 我可以依靠我哥哥帮我。
words.en: If you count on someone or something, you rely on them to support you or help you.

words.tr: phrase. v. 不把…考虑在内；排除；点数后排除
words.ex: Don't count out the weather when planning the picnic.
words.ex_cn: 计划野餐时，别把天气因素排除在外。
words.en: If you count out a sum of money, you count the notes or coins as you put them in a pile one by one.

words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能处理困难的问题。
words.en: To deal with something means to take action in order to achieve something or in order to solve a problem.

words.tr: 短语动词. 通过做某事来保护自己；为自己辩护
words.ex: She defended herself by saying she had no knowledge of the situation.
words.ex_cn: 她通过说自己对情况一无所知来保护自己。
words.en: To protect oneself by taking a specific action.

words.ex: This word derives from Latin.
words.ex_cn: 这个词源自拉丁语。
words.en: To obtain something from a specified source.

words.tr: phrase. 起源于...； 由...传下来
words.ex: This village descends from a small fishing town.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄起源于一个小型渔村。
words.en: To have a particular person or group as your ancestors.

words.tr: phrase. 献身于； 把...专用于；致力于…
words.ex: He devotes to helping poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他献身于帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: To give all or a large part of one's time or resources to (a person, activity, or cause).

words.tr: phrase. 消除；终止；废除；杀死；干掉
words.ex: They want to do away with the old rules.
words.ex_cn: 他们想废除旧规则。
words.en: To do away with something means to get rid of it or to stop using it.

words.ex: My parents disapprove of me staying out late.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母不赞成我熬夜到很晚。
words.en: If you disapprove of something or someone, you feel or show that you do not like them or do not approve of them.

words.ex: He felt dismay when he saw the low grade.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到低分时，感到沮丧。
words.en: Dismay is a feeling of unhappiness and disappointment.

words.ex: He showed distaste for loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 他对嘈杂的声音感到反感。
words.en: If you feel distaste for someone or something, you dislike them and consider them to be unpleasant, unattractive, or morally unacceptable.

words.tr: phrase. 对……的不满；对……的不满足
words.ex: The employees expressed their dissatisfaction with the new policies.
words.ex_cn: 员工们表达了对新政策的不满。
words.en: A feeling of not being satisfied with something or someone.

words.ex: He engages in sports after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后参加体育运动。
words.en: To participate or become involved in an activity.

words.ex: Everyone came to the party except for Tom.
words.ex_cn: 除了汤姆，大家都来参加派对了。
words.en: You use except for to introduce the only thing or person that prevents a statement from being completely true.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （消息等）传开；（人）走动，外出活动
words.ex: The news about the party got about quickly.
words.ex_cn: 关于派对的消息很快传开了。
words.en: To move around or travel, especially within a community or area.

words.ex: He tried to get across his idea simply.
words.ex_cn: 他试图简单地表达他的想法。
words.en: To succeed in communicating an idea or piece of information to someone, especially when this is difficult or complicated.

words.ex: They get along well with each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们相处得很好。
words.en: If people get along, they like each other and are friendly to each other.

words.ex: The thief tried to get away from the police.
words.ex_cn: 小偷试图逃脱警察。
words.en: If you get away, you succeed in leaving a place or a person's company. If you get away with something, you succeed in doing it without being caught or punished.

words.tr: phrase. v. （做坏事而）逃脱惩罚，侥幸成功
words.ex: He stole the money but got away with it.
words.ex_cn: 他偷了钱，但没有被发现。
words.en: To avoid being punished for something wrong that one has done.

words.tr: phrase. 回来；取回；恢复；报复
words.ex: He will get back tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会回来。
words.en: To return to a place, condition, or activity; to recover something lost or taken away; to retaliate.

words.ex: He wanted to get back at his colleague for spreading rumors about him.
words.ex_cn: 他想要报复他的同事，因为同事散布关于他的谣言。
words.en: To take revenge on someone because they have harmed you in some way.

words.tr: phrase. 进入；到达；插话；收割；当选
words.ex: He gets in the car every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上上车。
words.en: To arrive at a place, especially after a journey.

words.ex: He gets off the bus at the school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校下车。
words.en: To leave a place, especially in order to start a journey; to remove something, especially clothing.

words.ex: How is your project getting on?
words.ex_cn: 你的项目进展如何？
words.en: If you get on with someone, you have a friendly relationship with them. If you get on with something, you continue doing it or start doing it.

words.ex: He got over his cold last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周康复了。
words.en: To recover from something, such as an illness or a shock; to overcome a problem or difficulty.

words.tr: phrase. v. 最终找到时间做某事；着手处理（通常指拖延已久的事情）
words.ex: I haven't got round to cleaning my room yet.
words.ex_cn: 我还没来得及打扫我的房间。
words.en: If you get round to doing something, you eventually manage to do it, especially when you have been intending to do it for some time.

words.tr: phrase. 着手干；进行；（经常）表现得
words.ex: He goes about his work quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他安静地做自己的工作。
words.en: If you go about a task or problem in a particular way, you start dealing with it in that way.

words.tr: phrase. 参加；爱好；从事；赞成
words.ex: He goes in for football every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都参加足球。
words.en: To participate in or be involved with something; to have a liking for something.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细检查；复习；重做；转向；受欢迎
words.ex: I will go over my homework tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚会复习我的家庭作业。
words.en: To examine or review something carefully; to cross over something.

words.tr: phrase. 经历；仔细检查；完成；通过；穿过
words.ex: He went through a hard time last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年经历了一段艰难的时光。
words.en: To experience something, often something difficult or unpleasant, or to examine or discuss something in detail.

words.ex: My grandmother will hand down her old watch to me.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖母会把她的旧表传给我。
words.en: To pass something from one generation to the next or to officially give a decision or judgment.

words.ex: He will hand in his homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天交作业。
words.en: To give something to someone in authority, especially a piece of work or a document.

words.ex: The teacher will hand out the papers now.
words.ex_cn: 老师现在会分发试卷。
words.en: To distribute something to a group of people.

words.ex: He will hand over the keys tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会交出钥匙。
words.en: To give something to someone else, especially because you have been ordered to do so or because it is necessary.

words.ex: If only I had more time, I would finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 要是我有更多时间，我就能完成作业了。
words.en: used to express a wish that something had happened differently or that something would happen

words.ex: He likes apples. In addition, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果。另外，他喜欢橙子。
words.en: You use in addition when you want to mention another item connected with the subject you are discussing.

words.ex: In addition to apples, he buys oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还买橘子。
words.en: Besides; as well as.

words.tr: phrase. 与……联合；与……合作；由……共同举办
words.ex: The event is organized in association with the local community.
words.ex_cn: 这次活动是与当地社区联合组织的。
words.en: In partnership or collaboration with someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 处于某种状态；处于混乱或焦虑的状态；非常激动（或紧张、脏乱）
words.ex: The car is in a state of broken.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车处于损坏状态。
words.en: In a state means being in a particular condition or situation, often one of distress, excitement, or disorder.

words.ex: He is lazy, in a word.
words.ex_cn: 总之，他很懒。
words.en: used to give a summary or to introduce a conclusion

words.ex: The road inclines sharply to the top of the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这条路陡峭地倾斜向山顶。
