words.en: If you incline to a particular opinion, you have a tendency to think or behave in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 在视野内；看得见；在望；临近
words.ex: The boat is in sight of the shore.
words.ex_cn: 船在岸边的视野内。
words.en: If something is in sight, it is in a position where you can see it.

words.ex: I intend to go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我打算明天去公园。
words.en: If you intend to do something, you have decided or planned to do it.

words.ex: He is late in that he missed the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为他没赶上公交车。
words.en: Used to introduce a reason or explanation for something.

words.tr: phrase. 如果是那样的话；在那种情况下
words.ex: He didn't bring his book; in that case, I'll lend you mine.
words.ex_cn: 他没带书；那样的话，我借给你我的。
words.en: If that is the situation, then...

words.tr: phrase. 至于；就…来说；在...的情况
words.ex: In the case of rain, we will stay inside.
words.ex_cn: 如果下雨，我们就待在室内。
words.en: used to describe a particular situation or instance

words.ex: In the event of rain, the picnic will be moved to the gym.
words.ex_cn: 如果下雨，野餐将移到体育馆。
words.en: if something happens

words.ex: He cooked dinner; meantime, the kids did their homework.
words.ex_cn: 他做晚饭；与此同时，孩子们在做作业。
words.en: The time between one event and another; meanwhile.

words.ex: He is in search of a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他正在寻找一份新工作。
words.en: If you are in search of something, you are looking for it.

words.tr: phrase. 按次序的；合乎程序的；井然有序
words.ex: Please line up in order.
words.ex_cn: 请按次序排队。
words.en: In the correct sequence or arrangement; appropriate or required by the circumstances.

words.ex: I'm tired; in other words, I need to rest.
words.ex_cn: 我累了；换句话说，我需要休息。
words.en: Used to introduce a different way of saying the same thing, often to make it clearer or more understandable.

words.ex: The cost is in proportion to the size of the room.
words.ex_cn: 费用与房间的大小成正比。
words.en: If one thing changes or is done in proportion to another, it changes or is done according to how much the other thing changes or is done.

words.tr: phrase. 与…步调一致；跟上…的步伐；与…同步
words.ex: It's important to keep step with the latest technology.
words.ex_cn: v. 与最新技术保持同步是很重要的。
words.en: To maintain the same pace or level as someone or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 与…步调一致；与…同步；跟上…的节奏
words.ex: It's important to keep in step with the latest technology.
words.ex_cn: v. 与最新技术保持同步很重要。
words.en: To move or progress at the same rate as someone or something else.

words.ex: He works hard to keep pace with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以跟上同学的步伐。
words.en: To move or progress at the same rate as someone or something else.

words.ex: He failed the test because of lack of sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他因为缺乏睡眠而考试不及格。
words.en: The state of being without or not having enough of something.

words.ex: The path will lead to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这条路会把人带到公园。
words.en: If an action or event leads to a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 投标；出价；试图争取；谋求
words.ex: He will make a bid for the championship next week.
words.ex_cn: 他将在下周争夺冠军。
words.en: To offer a particular amount of money for something, especially at an auction; to attempt to achieve or obtain something.

words.tr: phrase. 为…做准备；为…进行筹备
words.ex: We need to make preparations for the upcoming event.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要为即将到来的活动做准备。
words.en: To make arrangements or get ready for something that is going to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 为…预先做好准备；为…预先采取措施；为…预留资金或资源
words.ex: The government will make provision for homeless people.
words.ex_cn: 政府将为无家可归的人提供安排。
words.en: To make arrangements in advance for something that might happen or be needed in the future.

words.tr: phrase. 编造；组成；弥补；化妆；和好
words.ex: He made up a story to explain his delay.
words.ex_cn: 他编了一个故事来解释他的迟到。
words.en: To make up means to form something by combining or assembling parts, to invent a story or excuse, to apply cosmetics, or to reconcile after a disagreement.

words.tr: phrase. 与…匹配；与…相配；使与…一致
words.ex: The curtains don't match with the paint color.
words.ex_cn: 窗帘与油漆的颜色不搭配。
words.en: To be compatible or suitable with something or someone.

words.ex: He has more than three books.
words.ex_cn: 他有三本书以上。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is greater in amount, degree, or number than something else or than expected.

words.ex: Please move along the hallway to the door.
words.ex_cn: 请沿着走廊向门移动。
words.en: To continue to move forward or to proceed.

words.tr: phrase. 离开；启程；（车辆等）驶离
words.ex: The bus will move off in five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 公交车将在五分钟后开走。
words.en: To start moving or to leave a place.

words.tr: phrase. 继续前进；转变话题
words.ex: He decided to move on after the breakup.
words.ex_cn: 分手后，他决定继续前行。
words.en: To continue with your life after you have dealt with a bad experience.

words.ex: He will move out next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周要搬出去。
words.en: To leave a place where you have been living and go to live somewhere else.

words.tr: phrase. 刚……就……；一……就……（用于强调两个动作几乎同时发生，主句通常倒装）
words.ex: No sooner had she arrived home than the phone rang.
words.ex_cn: 她一到家，电话就响了。
words.en: If you say that no sooner has one thing happened than another thing happens, you mean that the second thing happens immediately after the first thing.

words.tr: phrase. 与其说…不如说…；不是…而是…
words.ex: He is not so much a teacher as a friend.
words.ex_cn: 他与其说是一位老师，不如说是一位朋友。
words.en: Used to say that one thing is not the main feature or aspect of something, but rather another thing is.

words.ex: He has nothing but praise for his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他对老师只有赞美。
words.en: used to emphasize that something is only what you say it is and nothing more

words.tr: phrase. 属于自己的；自己专有的
words.ex: Every child should have a room of his own.
words.ex_cn: 每个孩子都应该有自己的房间。
words.en: belonging to oneself and no one else

words.ex: He spoke at the meeting on my behalf.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上代表我发言。
words.en: If you do something on someone's behalf, you do it for that person as their representative.

words.ex: He solved the problem on his own.
words.ex_cn: 他自己解决了这个问题。
words.en: If you do something on your own, you do it without any help from other people.

words.ex: You can enter the room only if you have a pass.
words.ex_cn: 只有当你有通行证时，你才能进入房间。
words.en: Used to say that something will happen or be true just in one particular situation.

words.tr: phrase. 在……条件下；以……为条件；条件是
words.ex: I will lend you the money on the condition of full repayment within a year.
words.ex_cn: 我会在一年内全额还款的条件下借给你钱。
words.en: used to say that something will happen only if something else happens first

words.ex: The police arrived on the scene quickly.
words.ex_cn: 警察迅速赶到现场。
words.en: If someone or something is on the scene, they are present in a particular place or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 展出的；陈列着的；供人观看的
words.ex: The paintings are on view at the gallery until the end of the month.
words.ex_cn: 这些画作在画廊展出，直到月底。
words.en: If something is on view, it is being shown in a public place so that people can look at it.

words.ex: He was late owing to the bus delay.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为公交车晚点了。
words.en: You use owing to when you are introducing the reason for something.

words.ex: I cannot part with my old watch.
words.ex_cn: 我无法放弃我的旧手表。
words.en: To give up possession or association with something or someone, often reluctantly.

words.tr: phrase. 捡起；获得；接人；恢复精神；偶然学到；加速；逮住
words.ex: He picked up the pen from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起了钢笔。
words.en: If you pick something up, you lift it up from a surface. If you pick someone up, you go to the place where they are and take them away, often in a car. If you pick up a skill or an idea, you acquire it without formal teaching or training. If something picks up, it improves or increases after a period of inactivity or decline.

words.tr: phrase. 主持（会议、仪式等）；担任主席
words.ex: The mayor will preside at the opening ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 市长将主持开幕仪式。
words.en: To be in charge of a formal event, meeting, or ceremony, especially as the person who introduces speakers or performers.

words.ex: The judge will preside over the trial tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 法官明天将主持审判。
words.en: To preside over a meeting or event means to be in charge of it and to ensure that it is conducted in an orderly and efficient manner.

words.tr: phrase. 拉回；撤退；收回；撤销
words.ex: The troops had to pull back to avoid heavy casualties.
words.ex_cn: 部队不得不撤退以避免重大伤亡。
words.en: To withdraw or retreat from a position or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 渡过难关；恢复健康；使脱离险境
words.ex: With the support of his family, he managed to pull through the difficult times.
words.ex_cn: 在家人的支持下，他成功渡过了难关。
words.en: To survive a difficult or dangerous situation; to recover from an illness.

words.tr: phrase. 拔出；驶离路边；退出
words.ex: He pulled out a coin from his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他从口袋里掏出了一枚硬币。
words.en: To remove something or someone from a place or situation.

words.ex: He pulled up the weed from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他把杂草从花园里拔了出来。
words.en: To pull up means to bring something to a higher position or to stop moving.

words.tr: phrase. v. 储蓄；储存备用；把…放在一边；暂时搁置
words.ex: He puts by a little money every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都存一点钱。
words.en: To save or store something, especially money, for future use.

words.ex: He put off his homework until tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他把作业推迟到明天。
words.en: To delay something or to cause someone to feel dislike or lack of interest.

words.tr: phrase. v. 使被理解；成功传达（想法、信息等）；推迟；延期
words.ex: He put over the message clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他清楚地传达了那个信息。
words.en: To successfully communicate an idea or message to someone, or to postpone something to a later time.

words.tr: phrase. 举起；张贴；建造；进行；提供；推举；提供食宿
words.ex: He put up his hand to ask a question.
words.ex_cn: 他举起了手来提问。
words.en: To provide someone with a place to stay temporarily; to build or erect something; to raise or lift something; to propose or suggest something; to display or post something; to increase the price of something.

words.ex: He reacts quickly when he hears a loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到大声响时，他会迅速做出反应。
words.en: When you react to something that has happened to you, you behave in a particular way because of it.

words.tr: phrase. 查阅；提到；涉及；指的是
words.ex: Please refer to the dictionary for the meaning.
words.ex_cn: 请查阅字典以了解这个词的意思。
words.en: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them.

words.ex: Too much sugar can result in health problems.
words.ex_cn: 过多的糖会导致健康问题。
words.en: If something results in a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 与某人就某事展开竞争；在某方面与某人相抗衡
words.ex: He rivals his brother for his father's attention.
words.ex_cn: 他和哥哥争夺父亲的关注。
words.en: Compete with someone for something, especially in a contest or rivalry.

words.tr: phrase. 在某事上与某人相媲美；在某方面与某人竞争
words.ex: He rivals his brother in math skills.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学技能上与哥哥竞争。
words.en: To compete with someone in a particular area or activity, often in a way that challenges their position or success.

words.tr:
n. 竞争者；敌手；
v. 竞争；相匹敌；
words.ex: He is my main rival in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他是我在比赛中主要的竞争者。
words.en: A rival is a person, group, or organization that you are competing with in the same activity or the same area.

words.tr: phrase. 带领参观；引导四处看看
words.ex: He will show around the visitors at the school.
words.ex_cn: 他将带参观者在学校里转转。
words.en: To lead someone on a tour of a place, showing them its features and facilities.

words.ex: He likes to show off his new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢炫耀他的新自行车。
words.en: If someone shows off, they behave in a way that is intended to attract attention and impress people, often by displaying their abilities or possessions.

words.ex: He did not show up for class yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天没有来上课。
words.en: If someone shows up, they arrive somewhere, especially unexpectedly or after they have been waiting a long time.

words.ex: He woke up early so as to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早早起床，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: with the purpose of; in order to

words.ex: His love of music stems from his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他对音乐的热爱源于他的童年。
words.en: If a condition or problem stems from something, it was caused originally by that thing.

words.ex: The new rule will take effect next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 新规则将在下周一生效。
words.en: If something takes effect, it begins to produce results or to work.

words.ex: He tends to arrive late for class.
words.ex_cn: 他总是迟到上课。
words.en: If someone or something tends to do a particular thing, they usually do it or they often do it.

words.tr: phrase. 太……而不能……（用于表达程度过高导致无法做某事）
words.ex: He is too tired to walk.
words.ex_cn: 他太累了，走不动了。
words.en: Used to say that something is not possible because a quality or condition is too extreme.

words.tr: phrase. 在……条件下；以……为条件
words.ex: You can borrow the car under the condition that you return it by 6 PM.
words.ex_cn: 你可以在以下条件下借车：下午6点前归还。
words.en: used to specify that something will happen only if a particular condition is met

words.tr: phrase. 以……为视野；为了看到……；带有……的景观
words.ex: The apartment has a balcony with a view of the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 这套公寓有一个可以眺望大海的阳台。
words.en: With the intention or hope of achieving something.

words.ex: She is studying hard with a view to getting a promotion.
words.ex_cn: 她努力学习，以期获得晋升。
words.en: If you do something with a view to doing something else, you do it because you hope it will result in that other thing being done.

words.tr: phrase. 在…能够得着的范围之内；在…能力或影响所及的范围内
words.ex: The library is within the reach of the students.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆在学生可以到达的范围内。
words.en: If something is within the reach of someone, it is possible for them to have it or achieve it.

words.ex: He spoke with reference to the previous meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他提到了之前的会议。
words.en: used to say what you are talking or writing about

words.tr: phrase. 一定；必定；无一例外
words.ex: He wakes up at 6 a.m. without fail.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上六点准时起床。
words.en: If you do something without fail, you always do it.

words.tr: phrase. 毫不犹豫地；毫不迟疑地
words.ex: He jumped into the water without hesitation.
words.ex_cn: 他毫不犹豫地跳进了水里。
words.en: If you say that someone does something without hesitation, you are emphasizing that they do it immediately and willingly.

words.ex: He studied hard, with the result that he passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，结果他通过了考试。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is the consequence of a particular action or situation.
